Curte tecnologia, inovação e tem agilidade no DNA?
Então talvez você tenha acabado de encontrar o seu próximo desafio!
Na Spassu, estamos com um projeto incrível no ar — e ele está prontíssimo para receber profissionais com aquele algo a mais.
Se você é Engenheiro Cloud - Infraestrutura e requisitos de segurança, tem perfil inquieto, gosta de aprender e quer crescer junto com uma empresa que valoriza ideias novas, vem com a gente!
Aqui, você vai encontrar espaço para expandir seus conhecimentos, aplicar seu talento e fazer parte de algo realmente significativo, inscreva-se e venha transformar com a Spassu!
Os CV's permanecerão em poder da empresa enquanto perdurar o processo seletivo e pelo período adicional de 6 meses, para eventuais processos seletivos futuros, em atendimento a Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados.
PRINCIPAIS ATIVIDADES: Profissional com perfil operacional que atua na sustentação, monitoramento e resposta no dia a dia da segurança em nuvem pública AWS, garantindo a implementação, a operação contínua e a resiliência (SRE) dos controles de segurança em tecnologias, produtos e serviços de nuvem. Atua de forma colaborativa com os arquitetos de nuvem e com as demais equipes técnicas, próprias e contratadas, para operar a infraestrutura e os serviços de segurança em nuvem pública segundo os padrões, requisitos e melhores práticas de uso dos recursos.
  • Operar e sustentar no dia a dia os controles e ferramentas de segurança em nuvem pública AWS, garantindo o funcionamento contínuo de recursos como GuardDuty, AWS Security Hub, AWS WAF, Amazon Inspector, AWS Config e CloudTrail, com registro das atividades e cumprimento dos níveis de serviço acordados;
  • Monitorar de forma contínua os eventos e alertas de segurança, realizando triagem, priorização e encaminhamento das ocorrências, e atuando na abertura e no acompanhamento dos chamados relacionados;
  • Executar as atividades de resposta a incidentes de segurança, atuando na contenção, na investigação e na recuperação, além de documentar as ações e as lições aprendidas;
  • Conduzir a gestão operacional de vulnerabilidades, executando varreduras, triagem dos achados e acompanhamento das remediações junto às equipes responsáveis;
  • Aplicar e manter baselines e hardening de segurança em recursos de nuvem pública e ambientes on premise, seguindo benchmarks como CIS e as políticas internas do cliente;
  • Operar os mecanismos de gestão de identidade e acesso da AWS (IAM), apoiando a revisão de permissões, a rotação de credenciais e a aplicação do princípio do menor privilégio;
  • Analisar logs e trilhas de auditoria para identificar anomalias, apoiar investigações e sustentar as evidências de conformidade;
  • Apoiar a aplicação de patches e ajustes de configuração de segurança, mantendo os ambientes atualizados e em conformidade;

Project – the aim you’ll have

Join a dedicated team of Polish and British developers, testers, DevOps engineers, Data Engineers, Project Managers, and Scrum Masters building innovative document management software to advance clinical research.
We’ve partnered with our client for years, working on a trust-based, collaborative model. Our work spans development (.NET, C#, React), automation (Playwright), and DevOps (Azure, Kubernetes, Terraform), with a strong culture of knowledge sharing and teamwork.

Position – how you’ll contribute

We are looking for a growth-oriented intern or junior .NET developer who already has solid C# basics and genuinely wants to learn. We welcome a proactive mindset, where you treat AI as an everyday coding buddy that helps you debug, research, and learn faster – not as a "magic button" that does the thinking for you. If you are ready to take ownership of your tasks, want to understand how your code works under the hood, and are excited to solve real business puzzles in a relaxed, no-nonsense engineering culture, you’ll fit right in.

Your daily tasks will include:

  • Developing backend tasks in .NET, maintaining APIs, and assisting with system integrations
  • Writing clean, testable code and creating unit tests with mentor support
  • Utilizing AI tools consciously for code generation, refactoring, debugging, and technical research
  • Participating in code reviews, internal workshops, technical demos, and analyzing bugs/logs
  • Collaborating closely with experienced developers and verifying AI-generated solutions before implementation

Expectations – the experience you need

  • At least 1 year of commercial experience
  • Practical knowledge of C# and willingness to grow within the .NET / ASP.NET Core ecosystem
  • Hands-on experience demonstrated through personal projects, a GitHub profile, or commercial exposure
  • Basic understanding of backend development, Web API, Entity Framework, and databases
  • Working knowledge of Git and the ability to read and improve existing code
  • Practical skills in leveraging AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Copilot, Cursor, Claude, Gemini) for debugging, research, and automation
  • Good understanding of AI limitations, including hallucinations, data security, privacy, and the necessity of verification
  • English proficiency at a B2 level or higher
  • Strong communication skills, independence, curiosity, and readiness to receive constructive feedback

Additional skills – the edge you have

  • Active GitHub profile or a portfolio of post-hours applications
  • Basic knowledge of SQL and database optimization
  • First experience with writing unit tests
  • Strong interest in work automation and productivity tools
  • Mindset focused on continuous self-development and problem-solving

What does the recruitment process look like?

During the interview, we will want to see how you think, solve problems, and use AI. You can expect a technical conversation and practical questions about .NET, C#, APIs, and AI tools.

We will look not only at the result, but also at your way of working:

  • how you analyse a problem
  • how you formulate questions for AI
  • how you verify answers
  • what you accept
  • what you reject
  • how you explain your technical decisions

Software Mind develops solutions that make an impact for companies around the globe. Tech giants & unicorns, transformative projects, emerging technologies and limitless opportunities – these are a few words that describe an average day for us. Building cross-functional engineering teams that take ownership and crave more means we’re always on the lookout for talented people who bring passion and creativity to every project. Our culture embraces openness, acts with respect, shows grit & guts and combines employment with enjoyment.

Company Description

Swiftly is on a mission to help cities move more efficiently. We are the leading transit data platform for agencies to share real-time passenger information, manage day-to-day operations, and improve service performance. Today, over 200 transit agencies in 12 countries – including LA Metro, MARTA, SEPTA, and MBTA – rely on Swiftly to improve on-time performance by up to 40% and increase passenger information accuracy by up to 50%. The result is better service reliability, increased ridership, and more efficient transit operations.
Even though Swiftly's HQ office is located in San Francisco, CA, we are open to candidates in most locations across the U.S. as well as Ontario and British Columbia, Canada. At this time we are unable to provide Visa sponsorship.

Engineering at Swiftly

Engineering at Swiftly is not only about writing code – we believe in creating empowered product teams that work together to conceptualize new features and bring them to life. Each team aims to strike a balance between delivering incremental improvements, creating prototypes to test new ideas and mitigate risks, and building scalable software using industry best practices. We’re guided by a mission to positively impact transit riders, and we embrace humility and intentionality in how we make technical decisions so that we best meet our customers’ needs.

raw.title: Account Executive (AE)
raw.excerpt: About OptimaFI OptimaFI helps community financial institutions (CFIs) - credit unions and banks profitably grow using a combination of proven data assets, expert consulting, and modern cloud software.
raw.description:
About OptimaFI

OptimaFI helps community financial institutions (CFIs) - credit unions and banks profitably grow using a combination of proven data assets, expert consulting, and modern cloud software. We are OptimaFI, striving to create solutions for CFI’s that enable better decision making, transparency, and improved profitability for our clients. Our values are Curiosity, Transparency, Partnership, and Lagniappe - always adding a little extra for clients and colleagues alike. We are an 80-person company growing to 100 in the next 18 months, and we have no intention of ballooning headcount for the sake of it. We move with purpose, invest in what works, and use automation and AI to stay lean and effective.

The Opportunity

OptimaFI already serves a meaningful share of the community financial institution market across software and services. This role is about accelerating software revenue with an experienced seller who can create pipelines, grow existing relationships, and close business across the portfolio. You own the territory and the work required to make it productive.

You will sell to banks and credit unions where reputation matters, and the market is finite. That means relevant outreach, strong discovery, and disciplined follow-through. Find the right institution, understand the need, connect it to the right solution, and keep the deal moving.

Key Responsibilities

  • Create the pipeline. Prospect through account research, direct outreach, relationships, referrals, events, and the existing client base. Be able to show what you personally created.
  • Own the territory. Build software revenue across both net-new institutions and current OptimaFI clients. Know where the best opportunities are and why.
  • Run strong discovery. Understand the institution's stated needs, connect it to the right solution, and know when to bring in a technical specialist.
  • Move the deal. Set clear next steps, maintain momentum, navigate objections and procurement, and carry qualified opportunities through close.
  • Keep the forecast real. Maintain accurate stages, buyer contacts, timing, next steps, and close dates in Salesforce. Requalify or close what is not moving.
  • Open doors for services. Identify qualified service needs and hand them to the right Services seller with the buyer need, context, and next step intact.
  • Help us learn. Record why opportunities advanced, stalled, were won, or were lost. Patterns should improve how we sell, demo, position, and build.

Required Qualifications

  • You've carried a real software sales number. You can walk us through quota, attainment, average deal size, sales cycle, and what you personally sourced.
  • You're a hunter. You have created meaningful pipeline without relying primarily on SDRs, BDRs, or Marketing to hand you opportunities.
  • You've done both. New-logo selling and expansion inside existing accounts. This is not an account-management-only seat.
  • You can own a complex sale. You lead discovery and the buyer relationship, use specialists for depth, and do not disappear when the conversation gets technical.
  • You can learn a portfolio. You are comfortable selling more than one product and translating technical or financial concepts into a clear business conversation.
  • You've sold into a market where trust matters. You understand that disciplined, relevant outreach beats noise.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Financial institution experience. Community banking, credit unions, fintech, financial software, payments, credit risk, finance, or another regulated B2B environment will help you ramp faster.
  • Experience in change. You have sold in a startup, scale-up, PE-backed, or evolving company where the process and support structure were not fully built for you.

You'll Thrive in This Role If You:

  • Create your own momentum. You do not wait for perfect leads, perfect tools, or perfect timing.
  • Ask good questions before pitching. You care more about relevance than reciting features.
  • Own the next step. You make it easy for buyers and internal partners to know what happens next.
  • Use experts well. You know when to bring in Solutions Consulting / Sales Engineering without handing away ownership of the deal.
  • Say what is happening. You communicate clearly when an opportunity is real, stuck, or unlikely to close.

Why OptimaFI

  • A meaningful market to sell into. OptimaFI has an established financial-institution client base and a broader software portfolio we are actively bringing to market.
  • Real ownership. This is a senior territory role with room to hunt, expand relationships, and shape how we sell.
  • Strong specialist support. You will have access to Solutions Consulting / Sales Engineering, Product, and banking SMEs without losing ownership of the sale.
  • A remote environment. We trust adults to do excellent work and expect clear ownership, transparency, and follow-through.
  • Benefits. Medical, dental, and vision coverage; Flexible PTO; a 401(k) match; and a work-from-home stipend.

The annual base salary range for this role is $80,000 to $105,000. This position is also eligible for commission-based compensation. At target performance, the anticipated on-target earnings (OTE) range is $135,000 to $175,000 annually, inclusive of base salary and target commission earnings.

We are committed to equitable and transparent compensation practices. Our ranges are informed by market data and reflect the dynamic nature of today’s labor market. Final compensation will be determined based on factors such as experience, skills and location.

*Eligible Remote Locations: AL, AR, AZ, CA, CT, FL, GA, IL, KY, MA, MI, MN, MO, MS, NC, OH, OR, PA, TN, TX, VA, and WI.

raw.title: Senior Director of Client Engagement
raw.excerpt: The Senior Director of Client Engagement is a strategic client and professional services leadership role at CampusWorks responsible for the successful delivery and client outcomes of a portfolio of professional services engagements.
raw.description:
The Senior Director of Client Engagement is a strategic client and professional services leadership role at CampusWorks responsible for the successful delivery and client outcomes of a portfolio of professional services engagements. Reporting to the Vice President of Client Engagement, the Senior Director serves as the primary point of contact for professional services delivery within assigned client accounts and is accountable for delivery excellence, client satisfaction, trusted client relationships, forecast accuracy, timely revenue recognition, and on-time and on-budget project completion.

The Senior Director leads professional services engagements from initiation through completion, including workplan development, project oversight, client alignment, engagement economics, and direction of assigned project teams. Consultants assigned to engagements are formally managed within the Services organization; however, the Senior Director directs their work on assigned engagements and provides timely and substantive feedback regarding their performance.

The Senior Director works closely with Resource Management, Services, Client Engagement leadership, and Commercial teams to ensure engagements are appropriately staffed, client commitments are achieved, risks are addressed, and opportunities for additional client value are identified. In collaboration with the Vice President of Client Engagement, the Senior Director supports account strategy and builds strong relationships across assigned clients.

This position requires strong professional services delivery experience, sound business and financial judgment, executive-level client relationship skills, and the ability to lead effectively across a matrixed organization. This position will be 35% billable.

Essential Job Duties:

    Client Engagement Leadership:

    • Own the successful delivery of professional services projects and interim leader engagements within assigned accounts, ensuring contracted services, deliverables, quality standards, timelines, and expected client outcomes are achieved.
    • Lead all aspects of engagement initiation, including transition from contract to delivery, workplan development, project launch, establishment of delivery expectations, and coordination of assigned resources.
    • Develop and maintain clear, actionable workplans aligned with the statement of work, client priorities, project milestones, resource requirements, and expected outcomes.
    • Define engagement resource requirements and collaborate with Resource Management and Services leadership to identify appropriate resources and make adjustments as client or project needs change.
    • Orient, lead, and coach assigned project teams throughout the engagement, providing clear direction regarding project objectives, client expectations, deliverables, schedules, and work quality.
    • Monitor engagement performance, milestones, deliverables, risks, dependencies, and client issues and take timely action to keep projects progressing toward expected outcomes.
    • Identify and address project delays, scope concerns, client dependencies, resource issues, and other conditions that may affect successful delivery.
    • Manage project closeout, including confirming completion of contracted outcomes, capturing lessons learned, and identifying opportunities to improve future delivery.
    • Manage a portfolio of concurrent client engagements while appropriately balancing client priorities, project complexity, delivery risk, and organizational commitments.

      • Client Relationship Management:

      • Serve as the primary point of contact for client stakeholders regarding professional services delivery within assigned accounts.
      • Build trusted relationships with client sponsors, executives, project leaders, and other stakeholders through regular communication, sound judgment, responsiveness, and a clear understanding of institutional priorities.
      • Lead regular client meetings and project reviews to communicate progress, confirm priorities, gather feedback, address concerns, and maintain alignment between client expectations and contracted services.
      • Understand clients' evolving needs and challenges and adjust engagement plans, within the boundaries of the contracted scope, to ensure work remains relevant and produces meaningful outcomes.
      • Help clients resolve barriers that may delay project progress, decisions, access to information, or achievement of expected outcomes.
      • Review project deliverables and work products to ensure they meet client expectations, demonstrate appropriate quality, and clearly communicate the impact and value of the work.
      • Act as a trusted advisor by helping client leaders connect project activities and recommendations to their broader institutional goals.

        • Project Team Leadership and Performance:

        • Direct the work of consultants assigned to professional services engagements in alignment with the statement of work, project plan, client expectations, and CampusWorks standards.
        • Establish clear expectations for assigned project team members regarding responsibilities, deliverables, deadlines, client interaction, communication, and work quality.
        • Maintain regular communication with project team members to monitor progress, resolve barriers, ensure accountability, and support successful project delivery.
        • Provide timely, candid, and substantive performance feedback regarding assigned consultants to the appropriate Services leader for employees and Resource Management for independent contractors.
        • Promptly identify performance, capability, availability, or fit concerns that may affect engagement outcomes and work with Services and Resource Management leadership to determine appropriate action.
        • Partner with Services leadership regarding consultant capability and readiness while recognizing that formal supervision, professional development, and employee performance management reside within the Services organization.
        • Participate, as appropriate, in the identification, interviewing, and selection of consultants needed to meet specific client or engagement requirements.

          • Engagement Economics, Forecasting, and Resource Utilization:

          • Manage the financial performance of assigned engagements within the levers available to Client Engagement, with a focus on timely revenue recognition, accurate forecasting, delivery efficiency, scope management, and gross margin performance.
          • Ensure engagements begin promptly and effectively following contract execution so that delivery and revenue recognition are not unnecessarily delayed.
          • Maintain accurate engagement workplans and forecasts and proactively manage conditions that may create revenue or delivery variance.
          • Monitor assigned consulting hours against the workplan and collaborate with project teams, clients, Resource Management, and Services leadership to address significant variances.
          • Manage project-specific utilization of assigned resources by ensuring consultant time is aligned with planned work, client availability, engagement milestones, and evolving project requirements.
          • Protect engagement economics by actively managing scope, avoiding unnecessary non-billable activity, monitoring travel and other project expenses, and promoting efficient delivery.
          • Identify opportunities to deliver contracted outcomes more efficiently while maintaining quality, client satisfaction, and the integrity of the engagement.
          • Monitor gross margin performance against expectations established at contract signing and proactively identify and communicate risks that may affect financial performance.

            • Client Growth and Business Development Support:

            • Listen for emerging client challenges, priorities, and unmet needs during normal delivery activities and identify opportunities where CampusWorks may be able to provide additional value.
            • Communicate qualified business development leads and client needs promptly to the appropriate Client Engagement or Commercial leader.
            • Provide delivery expertise, client context, and subject matter support to Client Engagement and Commercial teams as they evaluate potential opportunities.
            • Participate in client meetings, proposal development, finalist presentations, solution design, and other business development activities when delivery or subject matter expertise is needed.
            • Support account strategy in partnership with the Vice President of Client Engagement by providing insight into client priorities, organizational dynamics, project outcomes, emerging risks, and potential areas of future need.
            • Maintain appropriate separation between delivery leadership and commercial ownership. The Senior Director identifies and supports opportunities but does not own commercial negotiations, Salesforce opportunity management, contracting, or booking.

              • Portfolio and Service Improvement:

raw.excerpt: Why This Role Matters?  As a Senior Cloud Infrastructure & Platform Engineer at Cint, you will directly shape the core foundation that powers our global research technology marketplace.
raw.description:
Why This Role Matters?

As a Senior Cloud Infrastructure & Platform Engineer at Cint, you will directly shape the core foundation that powers our global research technology marketplace. Our platform processes real-time data from nearly 300 million respondents across 150 countries.

In this role, you will lead our primary technical OKR: modernizing our deployment ecosystem by migrating core workloads from Jenkins to Harness, while automating AWS infrastructure and empowering our R&D software teams with high-speed, self-service developer tooling.

What You Will Be Doing (Main Responsibilities):

  • CI/CD Modernization & Platform Migration: Spearhead our core business OKR of transitioning our continuous integration and delivery pipelines from legacy Jenkins to Harness. Automate software builds and deployments to eliminate repetitive manual operational overhead across R&D.
  • Infrastructure as Code & AWS Cloud Automation: Design, provision, and maintain high-availability AWS infrastructure (EKS, RDS, S3, ElastiCache) using modular Terraform, Docker, and Kubernetes. Ensure 100% Infrastructure-as-Code compliance across all platforms.
  • Developer Enablement & Internal Support: Serve as an embedded infrastructure expert supporting application development teams. Assist software engineers through our dedicated "Ask Infrastructure" channel, troubleshooting deployment issues, upgrading dependencies, and embedding DevOps culture across engineering scrums.
  • Observability, SRE & Incident Management : Enhance system telemetry and alerting across Grafana, Prometheus, and the ELK stack. Participate in an on-call rotation to maintain platform availability, with a structured 3-month onboarding runway before joining the active schedule.

What You Bring to the Role:

  • Cloud & Infrastructure as Code: Proven track record running production systems on AWS via CLI/API and building modular infrastructure using Terraform.
  • Containers & Orchestration: Strong practical experience with Docker containerization and Kubernetes management (EKS).
  • CI/CD & Automation: Deep understanding of the software development lifecycle, Git workflows, and build/release automation using Jenkins, Harness, or GitHub Actions.
  • Scripting & Tooling: Proficiency in at least one scripting or programming language (Python, Go, or Bash) for infrastructure automation.

Nice-to-Haves:

  • Direct experience with Harness CI/CD platform migrations.
  • Familiarity with multi-cloud architectures (GCP/Azure).
  • Experience configuring Grafana, Prometheus, or ELK telemetry stacks.

Our Values

Collaboration is our superpower

  • We uncover rich perspectives across the world
  • Success happens together
  • We deliver across borders.

Innovation is in our blood

  • We’re pioneers in our industry
  • Our curiosity is insatiable
  • We bring the best ideas to life.

We do what we say

  • We’re accountable for our work and actions
  • Excellence comes as standard
  • We’re open, honest and kind, always.

We are caring

  • We learn from each other’s experiences
  • Stop and listen; every opinion matters
  • We embrace diversity, equity and inclusion.

More About Cint

We’re proud to be recognised in Newsweek’s 2025 Global Top 100 Most Loved Workplaces®, reflecting our commitment to a culture of trust, respect, and employee growth.

In June 2021, Cint acquired Berlin-based GapFish – the world’s largest ISO certified online panel community in the DACH region – and in January 2022, completed the acquisition of US-based Lucid – a programmatic research technology platform that provides access to first-party survey data in over 110 countries.

Cint Group AB (publ), listed on Nasdaq Stockholm, this growth has made Cint a strong global platform with teams across its many global offices, including Stockholm, London, New York, New Orleans, Singapore, Tokyo and Sydney. (www.cint.com)

Additionally, in a world of AI, we want our candidates to understand our approach to the use of AI during the interview and hiring process, so we'd appreciate you reading our AI usage guide.

Who We Are

Cint is a pioneer in research technology (ResTech). Our customers use the Cint platform to post questions and get answers from real people to build business strategies, confidently publish research, accurately measure the impact of digital advertising, and more. The Cint platform is built on a programmatic marketplace, which is the world’s largest, with nearly 300 million respondents in over 150 countries who consent to sharing their opinions, motivations, and behaviours.

We are feeding the world’s curiosity!

Job Description:

Blake Willson Group is seeking a Federal Financial Analyst to support federal clients with accounting, financial management, financial reporting, and audit-related activities. The ideal candidate will have a foundation in accounting or financial analysis, strong attention to detail, and an interest in developing expertise in federal financial management. In this position, you will also:

  • Support federal accounting and financial management activities under the direction of senior team members.
  • Assist with general ledger and financial reporting data analysis, account reconciliations, and identification of discrepancies or unusual balances.
  • Support federal budgetary accounting and financial reporting activities, including SBR, GTAS, and related reporting requirements.
  • Review financial data for completeness, consistency, and accuracy and assist with transaction-level analysis and root-cause research.
  • Assist senior staff with researching and documenting accounting issues and preparing adjusting journal entries, including supporting calculations and documentation.
  • Prepare schedules, workpapers, reconciliations, and other accounting documentation.
  • Support audit readiness, audit response, and remediation activities.
  • Perform financial data analysis using Microsoft Excel and other financial or analytical tools.
  • Document procedures, analysis results, and conclusions clearly and accurately.
  • Collaborate with senior accountants, project leadership, and client personnel while incorporating feedback and maintaining high standards for accuracy and documentation.

Required Skills:

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, or a related field.
  • 1+ year of relevant experience in federal accounting, financial management, audit, or related fields, with experience working with financial data, reconciliations, account analysis, or financial reporting.
  • 1+ year of experience analyzing financial data using Microsoft Excel, with proficiency in formulas, filtering, sorting, and related financial analysis functions.
  • 1+ year of experience supporting accounting or financial management activities, with strong attention to detail, analytical skills, written and verbal communication, and the ability to document work and collaborate effectively.

Desired Skills:

  • Exposure to federal accounting and financial management concepts, including FASAB, GTAS, SBR, USSGL, or federal financial statement audits.
  • Experience with PivotTables, lookups, SUMIFS, or similar Excel functions.
  • Experience supporting audit activities, journal entries, or financial reporting.

A Brief Overview
The Payroll Analyst is responsible for ensuring accurate and timely payroll processing and reporting in a multi-state and multi-company environment. Research and resolve complex payroll and timekeeping issues. Provide payroll/timekeeping system support including executing payroll runs, reporting, auditing and testing. Ensure compliance with Federal/State/local tax regulations and Company policies. Partner with cross-functional teams and various business areas on payroll related projects and process improvements. Define payroll processes and internal controls and implement appropriate process improvements and collaborate with payroll systems to build requirements that impact payroll processing. Maintain current knowledge of payroll/tax laws and policies, interpret organizational impact, and implement required process and systems changes to remain compliant and efficient. Act as a Subject Matter Expert for payroll processes, providing guidance and training to team members.

This role partners and interfaces with all levels of employees within the company, new hires, other departments, and outside vendors, providing a proactive and positive experience while ensuring an efficient and compliant process. You will guide business partners, managers and employees regarding payroll compliance and adherence to processes, troubleshooting, resolving various issues, and communicating changes to stakeholders, including deliver training and documentation as needed.

Expected Work Location: remote

  • must be able to work Eastern Standard Time core business hours

Reports to: Payroll Operations Manager

What you will do

  • Responsible for ensuring accurate and timely payroll processing (regular, off-cycle and annual) in accordance with all federal, state, and local regulations and tax standards, bargaining agreements and company policies. Calculate and process complex and high-visibility transactions including FLSA calculations and compliance, incentive taxation, retroactive adjustments, payroll reconciliations, mass volume data loads and unique bargaining payouts.

  • Research and analyze complex payroll issues including reconciliations, overpayments, taxation and adjustments. Provide technical payroll processing, calculation, and consulting expertise on business and technology issues that impact how/when employees are paid. Communicate research and analysis results to a wide variety of audiences including senior leaders, associates, and external agencies and vendors. Ability to lead independent research and communicate findings effectively.

  • Build reports, analyze complex data sets and provide insights to stakeholders to inform business decisions and payroll operational efficiency. This involves using critical thinking skills and independent judgement to audit, identify and resolve issues in the data that may have a downstream impact on payroll. Participate in periodic internal auditing of key responsibilities. Must demonstrate strong analytical thinking and complex problem-solving skills with proficiency in Excel (e.g. Pivot tables, Vlookups)

  • Partner directly with both internal and external stakeholders providing excellent customer service in troubleshooting and resolving issues. Build and nurture strong working relationships with all levels across the organization and 3rd party providers. Designated SPOC for assigned functions. Consult and communicate payroll expertise to business in regards to issues and solutions that impact how/when employees are paid.

  • Support system implementations and identify areas for process improvements, including testing support. Lead and manage payroll-related projects independently, end to end. Drive and support process improvement initiatives and lead documentation efforts. Act as payroll SME and provides suggestions to enhance and streamline procedures. Create and communicate SOPs while validating policies and procedures against federal and state laws.

  • Maintain accurate payroll records, employee data, and timekeeping data. Review daily error reports to identify corrections to employee records. Communicate changes to business owners of upstream and downstream systems as well as proper tax and location assignment in the payroll / timekeeping systems. Review timekeeping audit reports to identify erroneous time entries.

  • Apply working knowledge of ERISA, ACA, IRS, DOL FLSA Compensation and fringe benefit programs to ensure adherence and compliance

  • Performs other duties as assigned

  • Complies with all policies and standards

Qualifications

Requirements

  • Bachelor's Degree or equivalent experience

  • 1-3 years of payroll experience in a multi-state, high volume environment

Preferred

  • Prior Wage and hour experience

  • Intermediate Excel skills

  • Prior ADP, UKG, Workday, and / or Oracle Fusion experience

  • CPP or FPC Certification

Skills and Abilities

  • Intermediate Microsoft Excel skills – Pivot tables, VLOOKUP’s

  • In-depth understanding of payroll laws, tax regulations, and accounting principles

  • Proficiency in payroll software and systems, including experience with advanced features

  • Attention to detail  to ensure accuracy in payroll calculations

  • Effective communication skills to liaise with various departments and handle employee inquiries

  • Problem-Solving - Ability to analyze complex payroll issues and develop solutions

  • Confidentiality - A commitment to maintaining the confidentiality of sensitive payroll information

About the Role

We are looking for a Network Automation Engineer to join our team. The role focuses on automation, DevOps practices, and software development, while also requiring a solid understanding of networking fundamentals. You will help improve infrastructure reliability and scalability through automation and integration of systems.
This role is a great opportunity if you enjoy building modern infrastructure, working with cutting-edge technologies, and automating everything that can be automated. You’ll help design and support big and mission-critical systems and take part in developing automation tools that make infrastructure more reliable and efficient.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Write and maintain software to solve complex network management and monitoring tasks. This includes deploying and auditing network device configurations, automating validation and testing procedures, and monitoring network health and performance with visualization and alerting.
  • Collaborate with multiple Engineering teams to incorporate network automation solutions into deployment pipelines.
  • Drive automation at all stages of software development, release, and operations.
  • Research and stay up to speed on network automation industry trends and projects, and apply them to improve team efficiency and innovation.
  • Support Linux-based environments and containerized applications and services (NMS, telemetry, flowspec and routing controllers, syslog, tacacs, netflow services)

Professional Experience:

  • Background in networking (TCP/IP, IP routing protocols)
  • Experience with Unix-based systems administration
  • Experience with network vendor devices (Arista, Cisco, Juniper, Nokia) and their automation interfaces
  • Experience in developing systems using Python

Technical Skills:

Programming & Scripting:

  • Proficiency in Python (scripting, automation, and working with data)

Network Fundamentals:

  • A deep understanding of network protocols such as TCP/IP, BGP, and OSPF

DevOps & Automation Tools:

  • Hands-on experience with Docker.
  • Knowledge of monitoring solutions (Prometheus, Grafana).
  • Familiarity with Ansible for automation and configuration management.
  • Familiarity with git and CI/CD tools.
  • Experience with databases (PostgreSQL, ClickHouse).
  • Experience with Application Programming Interfaces (APIs), and data formats like JSON and YAML

Nice to Have

  • Knowledge of Python frameworks such as Django, DRF, FastAPI
  • Experience with React for building internal tools and dashboards
  • Advanced networking knowledge: Flowspec, Telemetry, gNMI
  • Programming experience with Go

Soft Skills

  • Good teamwork and problem-solving abilities.
  • Fluent English

Benefits

At Gcore, we want you to do your best work and enjoy the journey. Our benefits are designed to support your growth, well-being, and life beyond work:

  • Competitive compensation
  • Flexible working hours and hybrid or remote options, depending on your role
  • Work from anywhere in the world for up to 45 days per year
  • Private medical insurance for you and your family*
  • Extra paid vacation and sick leave days*
  • Support for life’s important moments and celebrations
  • Language courses to help you connect and grow
  • Modern, welcoming offices with snacks, drinks, and entertainment*
  • Team sports and social activities*

*Benefits may vary depending on your location.

Equal Opportunity Employer

We provide equal opportunity to all applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, gender identity, gender expression, national origin, disability, or any other legally protected characteristics.

We're looking for good humans who bring great ideas, raise the bar with every task, and want to be part of a bigger story. Your work matters here.

Position Summary

IQ Fiber is seeking a Senior Broadband Network Engineer to serve as a highly skilled, hands-on technical expert responsible for designing, optimizing, and supporting IQ Fiber's core and access broadband networks. This role plays a critical part in delivering reliable, scalable, and high-performance FTTP services by leading complex engineering initiatives and serving as a subject matter expert across network technologies.

The Senior Broadband Network Engineer takes ownership of advanced network design, configuration, and troubleshooting across core routing, access networks, and transport systems, working closely with Network Engineering, NOC, and Outside Plant teams. As a senior team member, this role mentors junior engineers, drives best practices, and contributes to the development of standards, MOPs, and operational frameworks. This role also requires participation in an on-call rotation and after-hours support.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Lead the design, implementation, and optimization of core and access broadband networks, including FTTP (GPON/XGS-PON) environments
  • Serve as a subject matter expert for routing and switching technologies, including BGP, MPLS, VLANs, VPNs, and high-availability protocols (VRRP, ERPS)
  • Configure, manage, and troubleshoot carrier-grade platforms, including Juniper MX/QFX and Nokia 7750 Service Routers
  • Drive network performance improvements through proactive monitoring, data analysis, and capacity planning initiatives
  • Develop, document, and enforce technical standards, including detailed Methods of Procedure (MOPs) for maintenance and upgrades
  • Provide Tier 3 escalation support for complex network and customer issues; lead root cause analysis and post-incident reviews
  • Partner with NOC, Field Operations, and OSP teams to support network deployment, expansion, and operational excellence
  • Oversee and optimize network monitoring, alerting, and telemetry systems to ensure proactive issue detection and response
  • Mentor and support junior engineers and NOC staff, fostering technical growth and knowledge sharing across the team
  • Contribute to the deployment and support of public Wi-Fi and other value-added network services
  • Assist in the administration and support of Linux and Windows-based systems as needed

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in network engineering within a telecommunications or service provider environment
  • Strong experience with Juniper (MX/QFX) and/or Nokia (7750 SR OS) platforms
  • Proven expertise in service provider technologies, including BGP, MPLS, DHCP, VLANs, VPNs, and dynamic routing protocols
  • Hands-on experience with fiber access technologies (GPON, XGS-PON, FTTP)
  • Experience with network monitoring, alerting, and performance management tools; Linux administration experience preferred
  • Industry certifications such as JNCIS-SP, JNCIP-SP, Nokia SRC, CCNP, or CCIE strongly preferred
  • Ability to handle complex network issues with strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to work independently, prioritize effectively, and make sound technical decisions
  • Ability to communicate clearly and collaborate effectively across technical and non-technical teams

What Success Looks Like

  • Deep ownership of the network is demonstrated, with performance, scalability, and reliability challenges proactively identified and resolved
  • Complex network issues are resolved efficiently with clear root cause analysis, resulting in reduced downtime and improved customer experience
  • Network performance, capacity, and scalability are continuously improved through data-driven recommendations and implementation of best practices
  • Technical standards, MOPs, and documentation are well-defined, consistently followed, and contribute to operational efficiency and reduced risk
  • Cross-functional collaboration with NOC, OSP, and Engineering teams is strong, enabling successful network deployments and ongoing operational excellence

raw.description:
ABOUT SOTHEBY'S

Established in 1744, Sotheby’s promotes access and ownership of exceptional art and luxury objects through auctions, private sales and retail. Our deep expertise across 70 selling categories is supported by a leading technology platform and a global network of specialists spanning 40 countries. Selling categories include Contemporary Art, Modern and Impressionist Art, Old Masters, Chinese Works of Art, Jewelry, Watches, Wine and Spirits and Design, as well as collectible cars and real estate through RM Sotheby’s and Concierge. Sotheby’s Financial Services is a leading art lender and provides capital solutions for collectors around the world, having originated more than $12 billion in loans since its inception. Sotheby’s new global headquarters is now open at the iconic Breuer building at 945 Madison Avenue in New York City.

THE ROLE

Established in 1744, Sotheby’s is the world’s premier destination for art and luxury. The engineering that powers it today reflects that same ambition, built on modern technologies and modern practices.

Auctions are the most visible part of what we do, but every sale that runs through Sotheby’s is backed by the entire engineering organisation. The work starts months before a lot crosses the block, from the systems that support how we acquire and value inventory, through to the platforms our clients and specialists interact with daily, the identity and compliance infrastructure that keeps it all trustworthy, and the services that make the live event itself possible.

That breadth is what makes the engineering here different. Whether you’re working on internal tooling, client-facing products, platform infrastructure, or the real-time systems behind a sale moving hundreds of millions of dollars, your work connects to something tangible.

We’re looking for engineering managers who can build and lead the teams that own these systems. People who care as much about the engineers they work with as the software those engineers produce, and who are curious enough to learn a domain that will surprise them.

Our engineering teams are remote-first and globally distributed. It’s how we’re built, and it’s how we intend to stay.

We’re not async-only. There are regular calls, cross-team meetings, and plenty of direct collaboration alongside the written communication you’d expect from a distributed organisation. The balance works because the people here are good at both.

This role is London or remote within the UK.

IDEAL EXPERIENCE & COMPETENCIES

You’ve done this before. 3+ years managing teams of five or more engineers. You’ve hired, developed and retained good people. You know what a healthy team looks like and you know how to get there when it isn’t.

You have real technical depth. You don’t need to write code every day, but you can engage credibly with architectural decisions, review trade-offs, and spot when something is going sideways before it becomes an incident. Your engineers trust your judgment because you’ve earned it.

You deliver through others. You’re measured by what your team ships, not what you build yourself. You care about outcomes, not activity.

You communicate clearly and adapt to your audience. Whether that’s giving context to your team, presenting a plan to leadership, writing up a post-mortem, or navigating a difficult conversation with a direct report. You’re comfortable in all of those.

You create clarity in ambiguity. Priorities shift, dependencies tangle, and plans change. You’re the kind of leader who absorbs that complexity and gives your team something they can actually act on.

Required:

  • Proven engineering management experience with distributed or remote-first teams across multiple time zones
  • A strong technical background in software engineering, with enough depth to guide architectural and infrastructure decisions
  • Experience partnering with product management to define priorities and deliver meaningful outcomes
  • Track record of hiring well, onboarding effectively, and building teams that retain good people
  • A focus on engineering quality: observability, analytics and reporting, testing practices, and ensuring the team ships work they can stand behind

Useful:

  • Familiarity with our core stack: Go, Scala, React/TypeScript, Next.js, GraphQL, gRPC
  • Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS) and container orchestration (Kubernetes)
  • Background in real-time, event-driven, or high-value transaction systems
  • Experience establishing engineering standards, governance, or communities of practice
  • E-commerce, marketplace, or auction domain experience

RESPONSIBLITIES

  • Own the health, output and growth of an engineering team distributed across time zones, from hiring through to career development and performance
  • Partner with product management to shape your team’s roadmap, balancing feature delivery, technical investment and operational health
  • Set and maintain the quality bar for your team’s area of the platform, including engineering practices, observability, reliability and how work gets reviewed
  • Run the delivery cadence: planning, prioritisation, retrospectives, and the day-to-day work of keeping things moving and unblocked
  • Manage dependencies and communication across teams, reducing coordination overhead and making sure nothing falls between the cracks
  • Contribute to engineering-wide initiatives, whether that’s standards, tooling, process improvement, or how we grow engineers across the organisation
  • Handle incidents and operational issues alongside your team, own the follow-up, and make sure the right things get fixed
  • Give your engineers regular, honest feedback and create real opportunities for them to grow

WHAT WE OFFER

  • Private health insurance
  • Health cash plan and dental insurance
  • Workplace nursery benefit
  • Generous holiday allowance, Christmas shutdown, summer Fridays, and volunteer and wellbeing days
  • Great hardware

Senior Programmatic Trader (m/f/d)

Berlin, Bangalore, Remote

Hello👋I am Willian, Trading and Analytics Lead at Kayzen, and I am now looking for a Senior Programmatic Trader to join our team 🙌

About Kayzen

Kayzen is a mobile demand-side platform (DSP) dedicated to democratizing programmatic advertising. We enable leading apps, agencies, media buyers, and brands to run programmatic customer acquisition, retargeting, and brand performance campaigns through our self-serve and managed service options. Built on the three core pillars of performance, transparency, and control, Kayzen powers the world’s best mobile marketing teams with bespoke solutions that fuel business growth and deliver a competitive advantage. With an unprecedented scale of 300B+ daily ad requests from 1.6B+ unique users worldwide, we serve up to 1B+ ads per day in 180 countries. Kayzen is accessible through our APIs and user interface.

The Team

The Trading team is responsible for creating growth through the management and optimization of mobile performance advertising campaigns for clients utilizing the managed service offering. The goal of the team is to deliver on the client's objectives through established or new trading best practices and communicate account status regularly and effectively with their CSM counterparts.

Why this role

In this role, you will own and grow a portfolio of mobile programmatic campaigns (UA/RT) across verticals including gaming, fintech, betting, and CTV, delivering CPA/ROAS targets while scaling FCT and protecting contribution margin. You'll pair deep trading skills with analytics (SQL must have / Python desirable. What matters most: the analytical instinct to ask the right questions and the resourcefulness to find answers, whether through code or AI tools) and LLM-accelerated workflows to move faster than a traditional desk. You won't just optimize campaigns, you'll shape the tools, analytical frameworks, and trading playbooks the team uses to win.

What you’ll do

Trading excellence

  • Own end-to-end campaign delivery across multiple advertisers; hit KPI targets (CPA, ROAS, retention) and scale when unit economics allow.
  • Develop audience targeting strategies and supply-side optimization (audience, publisher selection, bid shading, dayparting) across ad formats (banner, video, native, CTV) to unlock incremental scale.
  • Build and execute testing roadmaps (optimization models, bids, budgets, frequency, creatives, geos, etc.) to drive incremental lift.
  • Manage pacing, budget allocation, and risk across an account book, proactively mitigating under-delivery.
  • Understand mobile attribution dynamics (postback flows, attribution windows, deterministic vs probabilistic matching, iOS privacy frameworks) and how they shape bidding strategy, audience targeting, and performance interpretation across MMPs.
  • Champion process improvements, author tools/queries, and mentor juniors to raise team throughput.

Analytics & automation

  • Dive into log-level and aggregated data to diagnose performance; write production-grade SQL (joins, CTEs, window functions) and Python/pandas analyses (or sharp use of AI)
  • Design and interpret tests, translating findings into the Trading Playbook.
  • Leverage LLMs (GPT/Claude) to automate recurring analyses (bid curves, cohort reads, anomaly triage), create data briefs, and draft experiments.
  • Contribute to internal dashboards and trading intelligence tools that accelerate decision-making across the team.

Cross-functional impact

  • Partner with CSM/Sales on growth plans and QBRs; influence Product with crisp, quantified feedback; collaborate with Supply on inventory quality.
  • Work with DS/DA on model inputs, new testing hypotheses or model improvements, and with Product Support to quickly unblock delivery.

Since I am based in Argentina and other key product and customer success team members are located mostly across EMEA and India, we are open to a remote setup of this position. For optimal overlap with customers’ time zones and internal teams your main working location should preferably be close to the CET time zone.

Requirements

  • 3–5 years of programmatic ad buying experience; mobile in-app DSP experience preferred.
  • Hands-on with MMPs (AppsFlyer, Adjust, Singular), postback flows, fraud detection, and reporting tools.
  • Data-driven decision making; comfortable building and modifying SQL queries (joins, CTEs, window functions a plus). Familiarity with BI tools. Familiarity with AI is a must.
  • Nice-to-have: Python/pandas for ad-hoc analyses and light automation; experience is a plus but not required.
  • Nice-to-have: CTV/OTT programmatic buying experience.
  • Solution orientation and drive to succeed.
  • Communication: crisp written analysis and cross-team collaboration. Client-facing confidence preferred.

What do we offer?

  • Competitive compensation with a performance-based component
  • Exceptional career growth. Shape trading playbooks, product, mentor junior traders, and influence the tools and analytical frameworks the team builds around you.
  • A unique opportunity to be part of an experienced team of industry experts and entrepreneurs who bring massive change to the Adtech market
  • A high degree of responsibility and independence
  • Direct, day-to-day work with the management
  • A fun, driven, and multinational team located across Germany, India, Argentina, Ukraine, Spain, the UK and many more countries
  • A flexible work-from-home arrangement
  • A 500-dollar home-office setup budget
  • A 1000-dollar annual learning and development budget

raw.description:
At Tutored by Teachers (TbT), we are on a mission to advance equity in education. We believe that when you put a teacher in front of a student, magic happens. Backed by some of the biggest names in EdTech venture including GSV, A-Street Ventures, and TMV, we are on a mission to close the opportunity gap and need a talented and motivated Account Executive to join our team. As an Account Executive at TbT, you will have the opportunity to make a significant impact on student outcomes by bringing our virtual academic support programs to schools, districts, and charter networks across the country.

The Role:

We're currently looking for a passionate, driven Account Executive to join our Sales team. We’ve already built relationships with some of the largest school districts in the United States, and we’re ready to start scaling our offerings even further!

In this role, your core job duties will include:

  • Owning the end-to-end sales cycle, from identifying and prospecting new district partners and stakeholders all the way through negotiating contracts and closing deals.
  • Building and maintaining a healthy pipeline of new opportunities.
  • Developing and executing strategic sales plans to meet and exceed sales targets.
  • Consulting with school administrators to understand their exact needs, and demonstrating how our services can support both their students and teachers.
  • Conducting presentations and product demonstrations to key decision-makers.
  • Constantly evaluating and refining your sales process and methodologies to identify potential areas of improvement or close knowledge gaps.
  • Developing processes for identifying at-risk deals and working across departments to mitigate concerns.
  • Using the knowledge gained through conversations with leads and new clients to help the Tutored by Teachers team continue to refine our product further. Communicating with other members of the Tutored by Teacher about
  • Collaborating with the Customer Success team and other departments across the organization to ensure successful onboarding and implementation of new clients, and to establish meaningful and trusted relationships within TbT.
  • Staying up-to-date with market trends and competitor activities
  • Traveling as needed to conferences or partner schools.

Requirements

There’s no such thing as a perfect candidate—if you read the qualifications below and feel like you’d excel in this role, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t match 100% of the qualifications. Traits that we’ve found are strong indicators of success in this role include:

  • Previous administrative experience at the school or district level (i.e. experience as a Principal, Assistant Superintendent, Superintendent, etc.). This is probably the trait we value most highly; selling to school administration often involves being able to closely understand the challenges that school districts face. We’ve found that AEs with experience in admin have found the most success.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills. You’ll be speaking regularly with school administrators: over email, conference calls, and occasionally in person. Being able to clearly and concisely communicate in writing and speech is vital to this role.
  • The ability to build trust and rapport. People buy from those they trust and like. We’re looking for someone who embodies compassion, warmth, and friendliness.
  • A desire to learn and grow. Maybe you’re always listening to a new sales podcast, or reading a new book. Whatever the case, you find genuine joy in learning and improving, demonstrated by your curiosity and willingness to explore new ideas and concepts.
  • The ability to pivot and adapt. Tutored by Teachers is a startup, and that means that what you do right now might not be exactly what you’re doing in 6 months. To succeed in this role, that should not only be expected, it should sound exciting. We’re looking for someone scrappy: someone who can dive in and start problem-solving wherever needed, and who genuinely enjoys it when solutions aren’t immediately obvious.
  • Success in sales, especially education or service-related sales. Ideally, we’re looking for someone who already has 3+ years of proven success in sales, especially if you’ve worked in edtech or (even better) in service sales—Tutored by Teachers is tech-enabled, but ultimately we’re selling tutoring services, which can be different than selling SaaS. However, we most value candidates who are quick on their feet and motivated to learn and develop, so if you tick the other boxes but don’t have as much sales experience as desired, please apply anyway.
  • A Bachelor's degree in Business, Education, or a related field.
  • Experience working remotely or in a virtual sales environment. Working remotely is incredibly fulfilling, but can be a tricky transition to make at first. Ideally, you'll have some experience with remote work.
  • A passion for education and closing the opportunity gap. We believe passionately in our mission to ensure that every child has the resources they need to succeed. We want every one of our employees to believe in that mission, too.

What can you expect in your first year?

Within 1 month

  • Gain a thorough understanding of Tutored by Teachers' services and value proposition.
  • Sit in on as many sales calls with our existing AEs as possible.
  • Begin identifying potential opportunities for partnership.

Within 3 months

  • Develop a pipeline of leads and begin actively nurturing those leads.
  • Actively engage with school administrators to understand their needs.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to develop customized solutions and proposals for prospective clients.

Within 6 months

  • Secure new partnerships with school districts, exceeding initial sales targets.
  • Establish yourself as a trusted advisor to school administrators, providing valuable insights and support.

And beyond

  • Continuously expand and strengthen relationships with existing clients, identifying opportunities for upselling and expansion.
  • Play a key role in driving the growth and success of Tutored by Teachers, contributing to our mission of advancing educational equity.

Benefits

  • 100% healthcare coverage for you and your family
  • Access to 401k to help save for the future
  • Well-rounded wellness benefits, including access to free and low cost mental health resources and support services
  • Fully remote work environment and a flexible schedule
  • Annual in-person team retreats
  • Unlimited vacation policy to help recharge
  • The chance to make a meaningful impact on students' lives and contribute to the advancement of educational equity

raw.title: Product Designer
raw.excerpt: At WorkWave, we are committed to empowering the hardworking service professionals who keep our world safe, clean, and beautiful.
raw.description:
At WorkWave, we are committed to empowering the hardworking service professionals who keep our world safe, clean, and beautiful. Through our powerful suite of software solutions, we give these business owners the tools they need to run their businesses more efficiently, increase profitability, and deliver exceptional service.

We are seeking a Product Designer to craft intuitive and efficient product experiences. You will partner with product and engineering teams to deliver high-quality design solutions for well-defined problems, creating and validating designs while considering the secondary consequences of your decisions. You will be part of our collaborative, diverse team who value winning as a team and innovating to change the industry.

This role is perfect for an experienced product designer who thrives on solving complex problems for non-technical users, has a passion for creating products that feel effortless to use, and wants to make a meaningful impact on the lives of hardworking service professionals across the country.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

    Product Design Excellence
    ● Transform customer and business objectives into compelling products that have purpose, simplicity, and are feasible to build
    ● Develop multiple solutions for defined challenges across our product suite. You will manage the design process from concept to delivery, ensuring your work is aligned with business goals and maintains a high bar for quality
    ● Manage the design process for your projects from discovery and concept ideation through flows, wireframes to full-fidelity prototype designs
    ● Ensure all designs prioritize the needs of non-technical users, focusing on simplicity, speed, and trust

    Collaboration & Communication
    ● Partner with leadership and product marketing stakeholders to ensure design concepts meet our customers' needs and deliver desired results
    ● Collaborate closely with business stakeholders, product managers, engineers, and other designers in a triad model
    ● Clearly present your design process, inspiration, and decisions to stakeholders, explaining the “why” behind your work
    ● Use storytelling techniques to communicate complex design rationale and build alignment across teams
    ● Share your work in design reviews to explain your decisions, triage feedback, and use it to iterate on your solutions

    Design System & Consistency
    ● Champion cohesion, consistency, and accessibility by delivering designs that promote our organization's experience strategy and design system usage
    ● Apply design system standards consistently while contributing to its evolution based on user needs.
    ● Connect multiple screens into cohesive flows and contribute minor updates to the evolution of the design system based on user needs.
    ● Across all work apply Jobs-to-be-Done methodology and user-centered design principles, conducting customer interviews and usability tests and translating findings into design iterations.
    ● Demonstrate a solid understanding of customer needs, core workflows, and key business goals, using this context to make informed design decisions with minimal guidance

    Mentorship & Growth
    ● Continuously learn new design skills to improve overall design delivery, while building depth in one or two core areas
    ● Coach team-level peers through their design decisions and share learnings with your immediate peers and the team
    ● Nurture WorkWave's culture and principles within your team and the broader design practice
    ● Participate in design critiques, in both presenting and providing constructive feedback that elevates team output
    ● Stay current with design trends, tools, and methodologies, particularly those relevant to AI-powered products

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

    ● 4 or more years of experience as a user experience/product designer, interaction designer, information architect, or similar role
    ● Proven experience successfully delivering product design initiatives that improved user outcomes or business metrics
    ● Strong portfolio demonstrating high-quality digital products that delivered results and showcase the depth of your design skills
    ● Proven experience clearly communicating design decisions and their impact on the customer
    ● Solid capacity to communicate and present complex problems clearly to diverse audiences
    ● Deep understanding of user-centered design processes and human-computer interaction principles
    ● Demonstrated ability to evaluate the customer and business impact of your design decisions
    ● Proficiency in modern design tools (Figma preferred) and design thinking methodologies
    ● Proven ability to evaluate the customer and business impact of design decisions using both qualitative and quantitative research methods
    ● Bachelor's degree in Design, HCI, or related field, or equivalent professional experience in the design field
    ● Demonstrated commitment to continuous learning and staying current with design trends and best practices

WHAT WOULD ALSO BE AWESOME:

    ● Experience designing complex workflows for enterprise or SaaS products, particularly in B2B environments
    ● Background in designing for service industry workflows or field service management
    ● Experience with enterprise product design or financial services product design
    ● Previous work on AI-powered features or data-driven product experiences
    ● Experience working on complex problems at a systems/service level
    ● Knowledge of Jobs-to-be-Done methodology and service design principles
    ● Understanding of accessibility standards and inclusive design practices
    ● Experience with design systems and component-based design approaches
    ● Experience mentoring junior designers or leading design initiatives
    ● Background working in cross-functional product teams using agile methodologies
    ● Experience presenting to and influencing senior stakeholders and executives

WHAT YOU SHOULD KNOW ABOUT US:

• We are laid back but buttoned up. We offer a casual work environment and remote work flexibility and have a passion for developing creative, innovative best in class solutions that directly contribute to the success of our customers
• We care deeply and deliver service and solutions that make a real difference in the lives of our clients and their businesses
• We openly accept others as they are and build strong partnerships based on trust
• Teamwork and collaboration is key to help our colleagues and customers solve their challenges
• Our team is energetic, fun, naturally inquisitive and eager to make an impact, we invite you to join us!

LOVE WHAT YOU DO, NO MATTER WHERE YOU DO IT:

• Join our Remote-First Global Work Community: WorkWave provides an innovative and dynamic remote-first Global Work Community that encourages growth, creativity, and collaboration. No matter what stage of your career or where you live, WorkWave is your place to be part of a global company with a startup feel, where your ideas matter and your growth is a priority.

A GLOBAL COMPANY WITH A LOCAL PRESENCE:

• We know that there are benefits of being in the office and working from home. WorkWave promotes a healthy work/life balance and provides employees with the flexibility of collaborating in the office or the option to work virtually if desired. Our teams are well versed at working collaboratively in a fully virtual environment.
• Our HQ is based at our state of the art home office in the historic Bell Works complex located in Holmdel Township, New Jersey. We keep our offices available to all to use when working remotely isn’t feasible, or to help with cross training, team building and/or brainstorming.
• We have employees in over 30 states, 7 countries and many regional offices - each with their own set of perks and opportunities to give back to the local community.
• Whether you work remotely or take advantage of one of our offices, you’ll find a community of WorkWavers that value diversity, and care deeply about our products, clients, our communities and each other.

RELAX, WE'VE GOT YOU COVERED:

• Employees can expect a robust benefits package, including 25 days holiday plus an additional 5 days of flexible time off

AND BEYOND...

• Comprehensive financial protection - critical illness cover, income protection, death in service cover and pension contribution
• Wellbeing benefits - Global Wellbeing Program, access to a private GP service, discounted healthcare and paid for counseling sessions
• Enhanced maternity, paternity and adoption leave and pay
• Retail discounts and technology benefits
• Paid time off for volunteering

GROW WITH US:

• We understand the impact of attracting and keeping top talent and reward intellectual curiosity and a thirst for personal and professional growth
• Encouraging our employees that already have an intimate knowledge of and passion for our products to apply for other roles within our walls just makes sense!
• Our employees have access to extensive video libraries for soft skill and role specific training available 24/7 and live trainings are provided throughout the year

JOIN OUR WINNING TEAM!

• 10 Time winner of Best Place to Work in New Jersey by NJBiz!
• WorkWave has been recognized with multiple awards for its outstanding products, growth and culture, including the Inc. 5000, SaaS Award, IT World Awards, Globe Awards, Silver Stevie Award for Employer of the Year, and Best Place to Work Inc. Magazine
• Recently named one of The Software Report's 3rd annual list of the Top 100 Software Companies of 2022 (worldwide!)
We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status: Don't meet every single requirement? Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. At WorkWave, we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you feel like you could make a great impact in this role but your past experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may just be the right candidate for this or other roles!
WorkWave supports salary transparency, however please note that salary estimates provided by websites (LinkedIn, Glassdoor, etc.) and not by WorkWave may not accurately reflect the actual salary range for the position.

raw.excerpt: The Senior Manager, College & Corwin Customer Operations leads Sage's global customer operations function supporting our College and Corwin education publishing businesses.
raw.description:
The Senior Manager, College & Corwin Customer Operations leads Sage's global customer operations function supporting our College and Corwin education publishing businesses. Serving bookstores, school districts, educators, and direct purchasers, the team supports a diverse portfolio of products and services, including books, conferences, and consulting.

This role provides strategic and operational leadership for a globally distributed customer operations team across the US, UK, and India. Reporting at a senior level, the successful candidate will drive service excellence, lead a high-performing team of Team Leads, oversee operational performance, and ensure a seamless customer experience through a follow-the-sun support model.

Working closely with colleagues across Customer Experience, Sales, Marketing, and Publishing, you will translate customer and operational insights into business improvements, drive continuous improvement initiatives, and ensure alignment with broader organizational goals.

About Our Team:

Our College and Corwin businesses support educators, institutions, and learning communities through innovative content, professional learning, conferences, and consulting services. The Customer Operations team is at the heart of that mission, delivering exceptional support to customers around the globe.

Operating across the United States, United Kingdom, and India, we are a collaborative, customer-focused team committed to service excellence, continuous improvement, and creating positive customer experiences at every interaction.

Your New Role:

  • Lead the global strategy, standards, and performance of the College & Corwin Customer Operations function.

  • Directly manage Team Leads in the US, UK, and India, developing leadership capability and fostering a consistent, high-performing culture.

  • Oversee customer service delivery, operational metrics, service levels, and customer satisfaction across all regions.

  • Partner with cross-functional teams to improve processes, implement guidelines, and enhance the customer experience.

  • Use data, customer feedback, and operational insights to find opportunities and drive continuous improvement.

  • Ensure effective collaboration across global teams within a follow-the-sun operating model.

  • Communicate performance trends, risks, and recommendations to senior leadership.

  • Build strong relationships with key collaborators across Sales, Marketing, Publishing, and Customer Experience.

Can You Be Our New Senior Manager, Customer Operations?

You may be a great fit if you have:

  • Significant leadership experience in customer operations, customer service, or a related function.

  • Experience leading geographically distributed teams and developing people leaders.

  • A proven ability to translate strategy into operational results.

  • Strong analytical and performance management skills, with experience using metrics to drive improvement.

  • A visible, hands-on leadership style and passion for customer experience.

  • Excellent communication, collaborator management, and influencing skills.

  • Strong collaboration skills and experience working across functions and regions.

  • A continuous improvement approach, with a track record of delivering meaningful change.

  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office, CRM platforms, customer systems, and reporting tools.

  • Experience in education, publishing, professional services, or a related industry is preferred.

If you have a disability and you need any support during the application process, please contact All qualified applicants are encouraged to apply.

Pay Transparency & Benefits Package:

Sage Publishing is committed to being an inclusive employer where all individuals are treated with fairness and respect. Sage is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer.

Compensation at Sage is influenced by several factors, including but not limited to skill set, nature and level of experience, qualifications, and other relevant considerations. Please note that the compensation details listed in U.S. role postings reflect the base salary only and do not include bonuses or benefits. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range and additional aspects of the compensation/benefits package for this position during the hiring process. If your desired salary falls outside of this range, we hope you'll still apply as there may be other positions that better align.

In addition to compensation, Sage offers a highly competitive and comprehensive PPO medical, dental, and vision care benefits package with Sage covering most of the premium costs. Unique program benefits that support a healthy life, a company-sponsored anniversary trip every 5 years, a 401(k)-matching program of 100% up to 5% of pay, and other significant meaningful benefits. In alignment with our value for education, Sage offers financial support for bachelor's and graduate-level degree programs as well as learning for personal interest.

Sage offers freedom and autonomy in your day-to-day with hybrid or remote work, depending on the role. Join the nearly 2,000 Sage employees worldwide who deliver products and services that serve to fulfill our noble goal of education and dissemination of knowledge globally. We’d love to meet you!

Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion

Sage Publishing is committed to being an inclusive employer where all individuals are treated with fairness and respect, regardless of age, disability, gender identity, marriage and partnership status, pregnancy and parental responsibilities, race, religion and belief, sex, or sexual orientation.

We believe that diversity is a cornerstone of a vibrant culture. We want Sage to be an organization where the most talented staff and high-potential staff are recruited, have the opportunity to grow, and want to work. We strive to achieve a better representation of diverse talent at all levels, including leadership, across our workforce.
