raw.excerpt: Role Overview: As the ProSidian Program Manager for Management and Operations Of Employer Sponsored Work/Life Universal Benefits Account (UBA) Programs (UBA), you will play a crucial role in overseeing a comprehensive suite of services to ensure the seamless operation of Multi-Sector (Industries) UBA Programs.
raw.description:
Role Overview: As the ProSidian Program Manager for Management and Operations Of Employer Sponsored Work/Life Universal Benefits Account (UBA) Programs (UBA), you will play a crucial role in overseeing a comprehensive suite of services to ensure the seamless operation of Multi-Sector (Industries) UBA Programs. This role encompasses program administration, reimbursement structure management, support services, monitoring and reporting, establishment of communication channels, financial management, and determining and communicating eligibility for participation.

Key Responsibilities:

Program Administration:

  • Oversee the day-to-day operations of Sponsored Work/Life UBA programs, ensuring efficient and effective delivery of services.
  • Develop and implement program policies, procedures, and guidelines in accordance with federal regulations and organizational standards.
  • Coordinate with cross-functional teams to streamline processes and enhance program effectiveness.

Reimbursement Structure Management:

  • Manage the reimbursement structure of UBA programs, including subsidy allocation and distribution.
  • Analyze subsidy utilization trends and make recommendations for optimizing subsidy allocation.
  • Ensure accuracy and timeliness in subsidy payments to providers and participants.

Support Services:

  • Provide guidance and support to program participants, sponsors, and providers on program eligibility, application procedures, and policy inquiries.
  • Address participant and provider concerns or issues in a timely and effective manner, fostering positive relationships.

Monitoring and Reporting:

  • Develop monitoring mechanisms to track program performance, compliance, and outcomes.
  • Generate regular reports on key program metrics, including subsidy utilization, participant demographics, and provider engagement.
  • Use data-driven insights to identify areas for improvement and inform strategic decision-making.

Communication Channels Establishment:

  • Establish effective communication channels to disseminate program information, updates, and announcements to stakeholders.
  • Facilitate communication between internal teams, external partners, and program participants to ensure transparency and clarity.

Financial Management:

  • Manage the financial aspects of UBA programs, including budgeting, forecasting, and expenditure tracking.
  • Work closely with finance and accounting teams to ensure compliance with budgetary constraints and financial regulations.

Determine and Communicate Eligibility for Participation:

  • Based on information provided by employees on the Work/Life Benefits application, determine the eligibility of potential childcare subsidy recipients as outlined in Annual Program Bulletin 18-403 or equivalent program guidelines.
  • Ensure timely issuance of eligibility determinations and communicate outcomes to employees clearly and transparently.
  • Collaborate with relevant stakeholders to address eligibility-related inquiries and provide guidance on eligibility criteria and application procedures.

Design and Issue Certification Forms:

  • Team ProSidian will take charge of designing and distributing certification (invoice) forms for childcare providers and employees. These forms will facilitate the submission process for payment of tuition assistance.
  • Ensure that certification forms are accurately structured to capture necessary details for subsidy payments.
  • Maintain a streamlined process for the issuance of certification forms, ensuring prompt delivery to both childcare providers and employees.
  • Collaborate with relevant stakeholders to incorporate any required updates or modifications to the certification forms to meet evolving program needs and regulatory requirements.
  • Monitor the submission and processing of certification forms to ensure timely and accurate payments to childcare providers.

Assist Employees and Providers with Completing Participant Applications:

  • Provide guidance and support to employees and childcare providers throughout the application process for the Management and Operations Of Employer Sponsored Work/Life Universal Benefits Account (UBA) Programs.
  • Ensure completeness and accuracy of Work/Life Universal Benefit applications by reviewing required documentation, including the Office of Personnel Management (OPM) 1644 form.
  • Assist childcare providers in completing Section IV of the OPM 1644 form for electronic funds transfer requests, ensuring smooth processing of subsidy payments.
  • Address any inquiries or concerns raised by employees or providers regarding the application requirements or process, offering timely assistance and clarification.
  • Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to streamline the application process and improve accessibility for participants and providers.

Headquarters Operations Support:

  • Conduct policy research and analysis to inform program development and implementation, ensuring alignment with federal regulations and industry best practices.
  • Support the development and maintenance of program policies, procedures, and guidelines, including drafting and reviewing documentation as needed.
  • Manage social media accounts and communication channels to promote program initiatives, engage stakeholders, and raise awareness about the benefits of UBA programs.
  • Provide administrative support to headquarters operations, including scheduling meetings, preparing reports, and coordinating logistics for events and conferences.
  • Assist with other ad-hoc tasks and projects as assigned to support the overall objectives of the Sponsored Work/Life UBA Programs.

Business Development and Proposal Management:

  • Market Research and Analysis:
    • Conduct thorough market research and analysis to identify potential growth opportunities and strategic partnerships for expanding the Sponsored Work/Life Universal Benefits Account (UBA) Programs.
    • Utilize industry data, competitor analysis, and market trends to inform strategic decision-making and identify areas for program enhancement and expansion.
  • Stakeholder Relationship Management:
    • Develop and maintain relationships with key stakeholders, including government agencies, corporate partners, and industry associations, to explore collaboration opportunities and enhance program visibility.
    • Act as a liaison between the program and external stakeholders, fostering positive relationships and identifying opportunities for mutual benefit and partnership.
  • Proposal Development:
    • Lead the development of business proposals, presentations, and pitches in response to various procurement opportunities, including Sources Sought/RFI/Pre-Solicitation, Procurement Forecast, and Solicitation responses.
    • Collaborate with internal teams to gather relevant information, develop compelling value propositions, and tailor proposals to meet the specific requirements of each opportunity.
    • Ensure proposals are compliant, competitive, and compelling, leveraging best practices in proposal writing and management to maximize win potential.
  • Collaboration and Innovation:
    • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including program management, operations, and technical experts, to develop innovative solutions and service offerings that align with client needs and market trends.
    • Facilitate brainstorming sessions and idea generation workshops to foster creativity and identify new opportunities for program growth and differentiation.
    • Drive continuous improvement initiatives and contribute to the development of new product/service offerings to address emerging market needs and opportunities.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in business administration, public administration, human resources, or related field (Master's degree preferred).
  • Proven experience in program management, preferably in benefits administration or human services.
  • Strong understanding of federal policies and regulations governing benefits programs.
  • Excellent organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
  • Effective communication and interpersonal abilities, with the capacity to collaborate across diverse teams and stakeholders.
  • Proficiency in data analysis and reporting tools.
  • Demonstrated leadership capabilities and ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment.

Note:

  • Monthly Subsidy Allotment calculation formula:
  • Monthly Subsidy Allotment = Current Annual Subsidy Allotment Balance / Number Of Months Remaining In The Current Period Of Performance (POP)

CORE COMPETENCIES

  • Teamwork – ability to foster teamwork collaboratively as a participant, and effectively as a team leader
  • Leadership – ability to guide and lead colleagues on projects and initiatives
  • Business Acumen – understanding and insight into how organizations perform, including business processes, data, systems, and people
  • Communication – ability to effectively communicate to stakeholders of all levels orally and in writing
  • Motivation – persistent in pursuit of quality and optimal client and company solutions
  • Agility – ability to quickly understand and transition between different projects, concepts, initiatives, or work streams
  • Judgment – exercises prudence and insight in decision-making process while mindful of other stakeholders and long-term ramifications
  • Organization – ability to manage projects and activity, and prioritize tasks

OTHER REQUIREMENTS

  • Business Tools – understanding and proficiency with business tools and technology, including Microsoft Office. The ideal candidate is advanced with Excel, Access, Outlook, PowerPoint and Word, and proficient with Adobe Acrobat, data analytic tools, and Visio with the ability to quickly learn other tools as necessary.
  • Business Tools – understanding and proficiency with business tools and technology, including Microsoft Office. The ideal candidate is advanced with Excel, Access, Outlook, PowerPoint and Word, and proficient with Adobe Acrobat, data analytic tools, and Visio with the ability to quickly learn other tools as necessary.
  • Commitment - to work with smart, interesting people with diverse backgrounds to solve the biggest challenges across private, public and social sectors
  • Curiosity – the ideal candidate exhibits an inquisitive nature and the ability to question the status quo among a community of people they enjoy and teams that work well together
  • Humility – exhibits grace in success and failure while doing meaningful work where skills have impact and make a difference
  • Willingness - to constantly learn, share, and grow and to view the world as their classroom

BENEFITS AND HIGHLIGHTS

At ProSidian, we invest in our employees to help them stay healthy and achieve work-life balance. Our team members receive a comprehensive benefits package that includes Competitive Compensation, Group Health Insurance Health Benefits, 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan Contributions, Vacation and Paid Time off (PTO) Benefits, Pre-Tax Payment Programs, Purchasing Discounts & Savings Plans, a ProSidian Employee & Contractor Referral Bonus Program, Performance Incentives, etc. Our comprehensive benefits package includes a medical, dental and vision plan. Our growing list of benefits currently include the following:

  • Group Health Insurance Health Benefits: Group Health Insurance Including Medical, Dental And Vision Insurance: Contributions are deducted from pay on a Pretax basis - Employee and family coverage is available with employer contribution of 50% of Employee (only) premiums under the Health and Vision Plan through Blue Cross Blue Shield NC (Blue Options Medical Plan Code: PB07840 / Metallic Level: Gold - - bcbsnc.com‎) and Dental Plan (Ameritas - www.ameritas.com).
  • 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan: 401(k) Retirement Savings Plans help you save for your retirement. Eligible employees can make before-tax contributions to the 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan to help you save for retirement. Contributions are deducted from pay on a pretax basis. A wide range of investment options are available with a personal financial planner available to assist you. The Plan is a Safe Harbor 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan. ProSidian Consulting participates in a Basic Match with a % of pay for participants who defer at least a required minimum % of their pay. The Basic Match is structured as follows: 100% of the first 3% of pay that is contributed; and 50% of the next 2% of pay that is contributed.
  • Vacation And Paid Time Off (PTO) Benefits: The flexibility of Paid Time Off (PTO) lets you set your own priorities. Eligible employees use PTO for vacation, a parent-teacher conference, a doctor’s appointment, or any number of events in your life.   • Purchasing Discounts & Savings Plans: We want you to achieve financial success. We offer a Purchasing Discounts & Savings Plan through The ProSidian Corporate Perks Benefit Program - Helping You Do More With Less: This provides special discounts for eligible employees on products and services you buy on a daily basis.
  • Security Clearance: Due to the nature of our management and operations consulting engagements for Private Companies, Fortune 1,000 Enterprises, and Government Agencies of all sizes; oftentimes there are Security Clearance requirements for Engagement Teams handling sensitive Engagements in the Federal Marketplace. A Security Clearance is a valued asset in your professional portfolio and adds to your credentials based on past, present, and future work.
  • Leverageable Experience and Thought Leadership: By collaborating with firm leadership, other members of the team, as well as Fellows and collaborating partners in what is a flat organization, you'll make valuable professional connections, interact with clients daily, gain leverageable Experience, and contribute to Thought Leadership while you build a basket of marketable experiences.
  • ProSidian Employee & Contractor Referral Bonus Program: ProSidian Consulting will pay up to $5k for all referrals (payments made after new hire has been employed for 90 days) for candidates submitted through our Employee Referral Program.
  • Performance Incentives: Due to the nature of our management and operations consulting engagements for Private Companies, Fortune 1,000 Enterprises, and Government Agencies of all sizes there are performance incentives associated with each new client that each employee works to pursue and support.
  • Flexible Spending Account: Pending

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
  • ProSidian Consulting has made a pledge to the Hiring Our Heroes Program of the U.S. Chamber of Commerce Foundation and the “I Hire Military” Initiative of The North Carolina Military Business Center (NCMBC) for the State of North Carolina. All applicants are encouraged to apply regardless of Veteran Status.
  • Furthermore, we believe in "HONOR ABOVE ALL" - be successful while doing things with the right way. The pride comes out of the challenge; the reward is excellence in the work. raw.description:
A leader in the payments industry, Elavon provides end-to-end payment processing solutions and services to more than one million merchants around the world. If you want to make a difference in your life, your community and your world, join us at Elavon. We know our company is only as strong as our people, and we are committed to your professional growth and success. Elavon is part of the U.S. Bank family, a diverse workplace, where we celebrate the individuality of each member of our global team.

Job Description

Build Your Career with a Global Leader in Payments
Elavon, a wholly owned subsidiary of U.S. Bank, is a global leader in payment processing and business commerce solutions, serving more than one million merchants worldwide. Backed by the strength, stability, and resources of one of North America's largest financial institutions, Elavon helps businesses of all sizes streamline operations, improve customer experiences, and accelerate growth through innovative payment solutions. At Elavon, we're committed to helping our employees grow professionally while making a meaningful impact on the businesses we serve. Whether you're looking to advance your sales career, expand your industry expertise, or pursue future leadership opportunities, you'll find the support, training, and career pathways needed to succeed.

About the Role
Elavon is seeking a highly motivated Business Development Executive to help accelerate our growth and expand brand awareness across Canada. This is a 100% remote, outbound sales role focused on generating new business opportunities through proactive prospecting, relationship building, and market development. Leveraging referral partnerships, industry associations, organizations such as the Canadian Chamber of Commerce, business networks, and strategic outreach efforts, you will identify, engage, and acquire new merchant relationships.
This role is ideally suited for a true hunter who thrives on creating opportunities, opening doors, and driving results through persistence and initiative. While you will support businesses across a variety of segments, the primary focus will be identifying and acquiring mid-market merchants with more complex payment needs and significant growth potential.

  • This is a fully remote telesales role, with no travel required. Success will be driven by your ability to prospect, network virtually, build relationships, and consistently convert opportunities into new business through phone, email, digital engagement, and virtual meetings.

**In addition to a competitive base salary, this role participates in a monthly sales incentive plan designed to reward top performance.

What You'll Do
• Build and maintain a self-generated sales pipeline through outbound prospecting activities.
• Identify and engage prospective merchants through phone calls, email campaigns, social selling, and virtual networking.
• Develop relationships with referral partners, industry associations, chambers of commerce, and other business organizations to create new opportunities.
• Increase awareness of the Elavon brand and value proposition throughout the Canadian market.
• Focus on acquiring mid-market businesses while supporting small and medium-sized businesses across a variety of industries.
• Conduct consultative discovery conversations to understand customer needs and recommend tailored payment and commerce solutions.
• Present and position Elavon's comprehensive suite of payment solutions, including point-of-sale, eCommerce, integrated payments, and value-added services.
• Manage opportunities through Salesforce CRM and maintain accurate pipeline reporting.
• Achieve and exceed monthly sales, prospecting, and pipeline generation goals.
• Collaborate with marketing, onboarding, operations, and customer support teams to ensure a seamless customer experience.
Preferred Qualifications
• Experience in merchant services, payments, fintech, SaaS, technology, telecommunications, or B2B sales.
• Proven success generating and managing a self-sourced pipeline.
• Experience prospecting and closing new business opportunities.
• Experience engaging mid-market customers and decision-makers.
• Experience utilizing Salesforce or a similar CRM platform.
• Strong consultative selling, negotiation, and closing skills.

Basic Qualifications
• Minimum 2-4 years of outbound sales, business development, or new business acquisition experience with a demonstrated track record of success.
• Post-secondary degree or diploma in Business or a related field, or equivalent work experience.
• Experience managing a sales pipeline in a fast-paced sales environment.

At Elavon and U.S. Bank, we invest in our people through:
• Career advancement opportunities across a global financial services organization.
• Industry-leading sales training and professional development.

• Leadership development programs.

  • Comprehensive benefits and wellbeing programs.
    • A diverse, inclusive, and collaborative culture where employees are empowered to grow and succeed.
    Why Join Elavon?
    This is a unique opportunity to help shape Elavon's growth strategy in Canada while building a rewarding career within the U.S. Bank organization. If you're an ambitious sales professional who enjoys hunting for new business, building relationships, and creating opportunities from scratch, we'd love to hear from you. At Elavon, your success is driven by your effort, supported by industry-leading resources, and backed by one of the most respected financial institutions in North America.

Consistent with Elavon's commitment to AODA best practices, if you require reasonable accommodation for any part of the application or hiring process due to a disability, you may submit your request through one of the methods listed below:

Email: ; Phone: 416-640-2640 x617232; Mailing address: Attn. Human Resources – Accessibility, Elavon Canada, 4576 Yonge Street, Toronto, ON, M2N 6N4

These options are reserved for individuals who require accommodation due to a disability. Information received will be routed to a specialist who will provide assistance to ensure appropriate consideration in the application or hiring process. Please note that specialists will not have access to existing profiles in the database and will not be able to provide any application status updates.

Benefits:

We offer an exciting, fast-paced and diverse working environment with employees of many different nationalities. We provide benefits to help you protect your health and financial security; and give you peace of mind. We also invest in your career growth with development resources that give you the opportunity to stretch and shine.

This is an Elavon posting. Elavon is a part of the U.S. Bank family

Posting may be closed earlier due to high volume of applicants.

raw.description:
WHO WE ARE

We are committed to a supportive, diverse, and inclusive culture, living our values of Rigor, Ownership, Curiosity, Kindness, and "Straight Up" to promote equality and financial empowerment. Intrigued? Say hello!

WHO YOU ARE

  • Exceptional organizational, analytical, customer service, and communication skills
  • Excellent critical thinking, independent decision-making, and problem solving skills
  • Must be well-versed with current Non-QM regulations
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, multi-tasked environment
  • Thorough knowledge of federal and state laws pertaining to the mortgage banking industry (i.e.: TILA, ECOA, RESPA, etc.)
  • Strong ability to independently review and clear Title documentation, Appraisal reports (including complex, unique property types, SSR’s and CDA’s) and Full condo project reviews (warrantable, non-warrantable, new construction)
  • Strong knowledge of Trust documents
  • Strong knowledge of LLC and Corporation documents
  • Expert knowledge of AUS (DU, LP) results
  • Ability to underwrite/review complex purchase and refinance transactions
  • Ability to work independently as well as part of a team
  • A full understanding of current FNMA/FHLMC underwriting guidelines is required
  • Recent experience underwriting Non-QM loan programs
  • Strong understanding of Non-QM borrower profiles, income, and documentation requirements
  • Have a high-volume non-QM underwriting background while maintaining quality, accuracy, and meeting SLAs

WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING

  • A thorough credit and collateral review of loan files to determine deficiencies and/or issues including calculating income using standard and alternative income calculation methods
  • Manually calculate income across all non-QM programs including complex self-employed borrower profiles, layered income sources and variable cash flow.
  • REO analysis
  • Reviewing title documents to ensure clear title at closing
  • Reviewing trust documents
  • Reviewing condo documents in alignment with client and investor guidelines for warrantable and non-warrantable condos.
  • Concise and accurate conditioning of loan files.
  • Meet contractual turn times for initial, resubmission, and CTC reviews without sacrifice to quality.
  • Analyze complex, high page count tax returns
  • Communicate (telephone, email, and/or client communication portal) with the processor, LO, and client account managers in a professional manner in order to assist in moving files to a final underwriting approval in alignment with the Close of Escrow and/or lock expiration dates.
  • Concise and accurate input of data into the LOS
  • Accurately analyze AUS (FNMA, FHLMC) results
  • Complete a comprehensive review and sign off of appraisals, SSR’s (CU, LCA) and CDAs
  • Clear conditions while meeting turn-time requirements
  • Maintain acceptable quality control and post-closing error metrics
  • Ability to train and mentor peers
  • Support and work on multiple loans for one borrower. You could have up to ten (10) loans for 1 borrower.
  • Evaluate Non-QM loan applications to ensure compliance with client, investor guidelines, overlays, and company policies
  • Identify and mitigate potential risks associated with Non-QM loans
  • Read and interpret multiple sets of client and investor underwriting guidelines

IDEALLY, YOU’LL HAVE

  • 5+ years recent, hands-on experience in Non-QM underwriting
  • Experience with Non-QM loan origination systems and software
  • Experience and demonstrated ability to calculate full and alternative document income methods (DSCR, 1099, asset utilization, asset depletion, 12 and 24-month bank statement, tax returns, VOE, P&L, short-/long-term rental income - or any combination thereof which could also include W2, OT, bonus, and commission, Retirement, SSN, Alimony, child support, monthly maintenance)
  • Compensation Range: $36.06/hr - $38.46/hr depending on experience.

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

Here, you get an opportunity to be a vital part of an agile team of thinkers and doers collaborating to change a multi-trillion dollar industry. We offer meaningful equity, a competitive salary, top-tier medical, dental, and vision insurance, flexible work hours, and vacation time.

raw.title: Incident Response & Threat Intelligence Lead​
raw.excerpt: About UsSophos is a cybersecurity leader defending 600,000 organizations globally with an AI-driven platform and expert-led services.
raw.description:
About Us

Sophos is a cybersecurity leader defending 600,000 organizations globally with an AI-driven platform and expert-led services. Sophos meets organizations wherever they are in their security maturity and grows with them to defeat cyberattacks. Its solutions combine machine learning, automation, and real-time threat intelligence with frontline human expertise from Sophos X-Ops to deliver advanced, 24/7 threat monitoring, detection, and response.
Sophos offers industry-leading managed detection and response (MDR) alongside a comprehensive portfolio of cybersecurity technologies — including endpoint, network, email, and cloud security, extended detection and response (XDR), identity threat detection and response (ITDR), and next-gen SIEM. Together with expert advisory services, these capabilities help organizations proactively reduce risk and respond faster, with the visibility and scalability needed to stay ahead of evolving threats.
Sophos goes to market with a global partner ecosystem, including Managed Service Providers (MSPs), Managed Security Service Providers (MSSPs), resellers and distributors, marketplace integrations, and cyber risk partners, giving organizations the flexibility to choose trusted relationships when securing their business. Sophos is headquartered in Oxford, U.K. More information is available at .

Role Summary

インシデント対応および脅威インテリジェンスのリーダーは、日々高度化するセキュリティ脅威への対応において、お客様を支援します。インシデント発生時の対応を支援するだけでなく、効果的なインシデント対応に向けた事前準備も支援します。小規模なインシデントから複雑で大規模インシデントまで、技術的な調査を実施し、攻撃者の行動に基づいてインシデントの根本原因と範囲を特定し、推奨される対応戦略を提供することでお客様を支援します。

さらに、この役割はソフォスの脅威対策ユニット（CTU）との主要な連絡窓口として、調査結果に攻撃者の戦術、技術、インフラに関する最新のインテリジェンスを反映させます。また、運用上の知見を、お客様や社内チーム向けの実行可能なガイダンスに変換する役割も担います。

リーダーは技術レベルおよび経営層向けの質の高いプレゼンテーションやブリーフィングを行う責任も担います。これには、調査結果の提示、脅威インテリジェンスの動向の説明、多様な聴衆に対して対応策の推奨事項を明確に伝達し、情報に基づいた意思決定を支援することが含まれます。

Incident Response & Threat Intelligence Leads support clients in managing increasingly sophisticated security threats daily. They not only assist in responding to incidents as they occur but also help clients prepare in advance for effective incident response. Whether handling small‑scale or complex, large‑scale incidents, we assist clients by conducting technical investigations, identifying the root cause and scope of the incident based on attacker behavior, and providing recommended response strategies.

In addition, this role will act as a key liaison with the Sophos Counter Threat Unit, ensuring investigative findings are enriched with the latest intelligence on attacker tactics, techniques, and infrastructure. The role also translates operational intelligence into actionable guidance for clients and internal teams.

Leads are also responsible for delivering high‑quality presentations and briefings, both technical and executive‑level. This includes presenting investigation findings, explaining threat intelligence trends, and clearly communicating response recommendations to diverse audiences to support informed decision‑making.

What You Will Do

    • 担当案件を主導し、顧客のサイバーインシデントの調査、封じ込め、対応を行い、困難でストレスの高い状況にある顧客を支援する。場合によっては、通常とは異なる勤務時間となることもあります。

    • Windows、Mac、Linux/Unix プラットフォームを含む複数のプラットフォームにおいて、インシデント対応調査、封じ込め、根本原因分析活動を実施する。

    • ソフォスツールを活用して大規模な調査を行い、エンドポイントおよびネットワーク上の証拠を検証する。

    • 顧客案件全体を統括し、顧客の上級ステークホルダーとのコミュニケーションを主導する。

    • インシデント対応の一環として、他の社内チームと連携し、優先順位を設定する。

    • 顧客対応における状況や懸念事項について、ソフォスの上級管理職に効果的に報告する。

    • 顧客のステークホルダーに対し、質の高い文書および口頭での報告、提言、調査結果を提示する。

    • 攻撃者のTTP（戦術、技術、手順）を特定・体系化し、現在および将来の調査やツールの改善に役立てる。

    • SophosLabs、セキュリティチーム、ITチームと連携し、セキュリティインシデントに対応するための是正措置計画を実施する。

    • 最新のサイバーセキュリティツールと脅威の動向を常に把握し、顧客に適切なアドバイスを提供する。

    • 社内の脅威インテリジェンスチームとの主要な連絡窓口となり、攻撃者の戦術、手法、インフラに関する最新情報を調査や顧客向け成果物に反映させ、対応戦略を強化する。

    • 複雑な脅威インテリジェンスを、顧客にとって明確かつ実用的な知見へと変換し、傾向、攻撃者の行動、想定される攻撃シナリオを提示することで、意思決定を支援し、顧客の全体的なセキュリティ体制を向上させる。

    • Lead assignedengagements to investigate, contain and respond to customers’ cyber incidents, helping them through difficult and stressful times, which may involve non-traditional working hours. 

    • Perform incident response investigations, containment and root cause analysis activities across multiple platforms including Windows, Mac, Linux/Unix platforms. 

    • Utilise Sophos tools to conduct large-scale investigations and examine endpoint and network-based evidence

    • Own the customer engagement including leading communications with the customer’s senior stakeholders 

    • Liaise with other internal teams to set priorities as part of the incident response. 

    • Effectively report on the status and any points of concern within customer engagements to senior management within Sophos. 

    • Produce high-quality written and verbal communications, recommendations, and findings to customer stakeholders. 

    • Recognise and codify attacker TTPsto enhance current and future investigations and tooling.

    • Work with SophosLabs, security and IT teams to implement remediation plans in response to security incidents. 

    • Maintain awareness of current cyber security tools and threat landscape in order to advise customers appropriately.

    • Serve as the primary liaison with internal threat intelligence teams, integrating timely intelligence on attacker tactics, techniques, and infrastructure into investigations and client deliverables to strengthen response strategies.

    • Translate complex threat intelligence into clear, actionable insights for clients, presenting trends, adversary behaviours, and likely attack scenarios in a way that supports decision‑making and improves clients’ overall security posture.

What You Will Bring

    • 日本語に堪能であること。

    • 週末、休日、祝日を含む通常の業務時間外でも、クライアントのインシデント対応に柔軟に対応できること。

    • 組織において体系的にインシデント対応調査を主導し、顧客環境に影響を与える標的型脅威の調査を行った経験が5年以上あること。

    • Encase、FTK、X-Ways、CYLR、Autopsy、Magnet Forensics、または1つ以上のオープンソースフォレンジックツールの使用経験。

    • Microsoft 365環境におけるフォレンジック調査の実施経験。

    • セキュリティ脅威、脆弱性、および「Living off the Land」手法に関する深い理解。

    • チーム環境においても、個人としてもすぐれたパフォーマンスを発揮できること。

    • 困難な状況下でも強力なリーダーシップを発揮し、常にプロフェッショナルで冷静かつ専門的な態度を維持できること。

    • チームメンバーそれぞれの強みとスキルを活かし、インシデント対応を成功に導く能力。

    • 現代の脅威、TTP（戦術・技術・手順）、およびMITRE ATT&CKマトリックスに関する高度な技術的理解。

    • 優れたレポート作成能力およびコミュニケーション能力。 

      • 【応募要件 - 歓迎（WANT）】

      • 英語に堪能であること。

      • ソフォスのセキュリティソリューションおよびその他の定評のあるEDRソリューションの使用経験。

      • AWS環境におけるフォレンジック調査の実務経験。

      • 業界を問わず、規模や地理的条件の異なる組織へのサポート経験。

      • 脅威ハンティングの実務経験。

      • Windows、Mac、Linuxベースのオペレーティングシステムの管理およびサポート経験。

      • OSQuery（またはSQL）に関する知識。

      • GCIH、GCFA、GCFEのいずれかの資格を少なくとも1つ保有していること。高度な情報セキュリティ認定資格は必須ではないが、あれば尚可。

      • セキュリティインシデントの根本原因の特定とセキュリティ体制改善のための推奨事項の提示による解決能力。

      • 業界でのプレゼンテーション、ブログ、メディア記事などを通じた思想的リーダーシップを発揮した実績。

    • Proficiency in the Japanese language.

    • Open to work outside of standard business hours including weekends, on call rotations and holidays to respond to our clients incidents.

    • 5+ years of experience leading incident response investigations in a methodical manner for organisations and investigating targeted threats impacting customer environments 

    • Experience with Encase, FTK, X-Ways, CYLR, Autopsy, Magnet Forensics or one or more open-source forensic tool(s).

    • Experience conducting forensics in Microsoft 365 environments.

    • Deep understanding of security threats, vulnerabilities and ‘Living off the Land’ techniques. 

    • Able to thrive within a team environment as well as on an individual basis.

    • Demonstrate strong leadership in challenging environments, maintaining a professional, calm, and expert manner at all times. 

    • Ability to use individual team members’ strengths and skills to successfully lead an incident response. 

    • Good technical understanding of modern threats, TTPs, and the MITRE ATT&CK Matrix. 

    • Strong report-writing and communication skills.   

    Desirable

    • Fluent in English language.

    • Experience with Sophos security solutions and other recognised EDR solutions.

    • Experience conducting forensics in AWS environments.

    • Experience of supporting organisations of different sizes and geographical locations, across industries.  

    • Threat hunting experience.

    • Experience administering and supporting Windows, Mac and Linux based operating systems 

    • Understanding of OSQuery (or SQL).

    • At least one certification in GCIH, GCFA, GCFE. Advanced Information Security certifications preferred but not required.

    • Resolution of security incidents by identifying root cause and security posture improvement recommendations. 

    • Demonstrated thought leadership through industry presentations, blogs, media articles, etc.

     

私たちから皆様へ：

    Sophosは、多様性と包摂性（インクルージョン）に富んだ職場環境を誇りとし、機会の平等を重視しています。私たちは、多様性と卓越性が組み合わさることで、より良いSophosが築かれると信じています。そのため、チームの多様性に貢献できる方からのご応募を歓迎します。すべての応募者は、性別、性自認、性別移行、婚姻状況、人種、宗教・信条、肌の色、年齢、退役軍人としての地位、障害、妊娠・出産、性的指向といった要素に関わらず、公正かつ平等に扱われます。私たちは、皆様がご自身の魅力を最大限に発揮できるようサポートしたいと考えています。採用・選考プロセスにおいて何らかの配慮や調整が必要な場合は、どうぞお知らせください 。

Ready to Join Us?

At Sophos, we believe in the power of diverse perspectives to fuel innovation. Research shows that candidates sometimes hesitate to apply if they don't check every box in a job description. We challenge that notion. Your unique experiences and skills might be exactly what we need to enhance our team. Don't let a checklist hold you back – we encourage you to apply.

What's Great About Sophos?

· Our people – we innovate and create, all of which are accompanied by a great sense of fun and team spirit

Our Commitment To You

We want to give you every opportunity to show us your best self, so if there are any adjustments we could make to the recruitment and selection process to support you, please let us know.

Data Protection

If you would like Sophos to delete or update your details at any time, please follow the steps set out in the Privacy Policy describing your individual rights. For more information on Sophos’ data protection practices, please consult our Privacy Policy Cybersecurity as a Service Delivered | Sophos

raw.title: Vice President, Client Partnership
raw.excerpt: The VP, Client Partnership is responsible for client success and growth across a large portfolio of clients.
raw.description:
The VP, Client Partnership is responsible for client success and growth across a large portfolio of clients. They are accountable for the overall partnership between Ansira and the clients in their portfolio, working closely with their Client Engagement team who is accountable for managing existing scopes, account planning and delivery. This person brings together the right team of agency solution leads and subject matter experts to drive profitable sales growth that expands our footprint and influences the client's strategy through knowledge, innovation and thought leadership. Key requirements for this role are strong leadership, subject matter expertise in channel partner and digital marketing, especially in the automotive and retail space. Demonstrated success in selling and growing client revenue – both in new logos and existing clients. In addition, there is a focus on creative problem solving and impact storytelling that identifies solutions to address client challenges, provides proactive communication, and elicits a passion for client success. The portfolio under management for this role includes consulting work, further emphasizing the need for storytelling and cause/effect selling expertise. Must be able to manage multiple clients across several client partnership teams.

DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Accountable for managing a client portfolio that delivers $10M+ annually
  • Responsible for financial health and growth across a portfolio of accounts
  • Achieves revenue and margin goals for a portfolio of accounts and able to lead forecasting, scoping/billing, and revenue recognition discussions with LT
  • Accountable for identifying, pitching, and converting growth opportunities in consideration of revenue growth goals
  • Strong understanding of the client's business, their context within the industry and competitive position, and how Ansira’s work has an impact
  • Understand the capabilities of all agency departments to effectively lead the Ansira team to identify, pitch, and convert sales opportunities
  • Ensures the team working on their portfolio understands client goals to meet and exceed expectations and is a participant in internal and external ideation and brainstorming sessions
  • Responsible for the building, development, and professional growth of a high-performing team
  • Ensures cross-training and succession planning is woven into the team construct and approach
  • Exhibits an understanding of digital delivery across creative, strategy, and technology platforms. Leverages this knowledge to build and fit into a client’s digital transformation agenda
  • Thinks and leads strategically; Looks ahead, leads with a vision, and proactively takes appropriate action to drive solutions that accelerate your client's business forward
  • Shares accountability with CE team for overall client satisfaction and client NPS scores across their portfolio of clients
  • Supports CE team in escalating red flags for current projects and ongoing work to Sr. Leadership and SMEs and developing the plan for resolution.
  • Lead overall training and support of your team, helping them grow and mature in their ability to perform their job successfully
  • Manages the gathering of information and helps define the storyline for marketing proposals and other decks presented internally and externally
  • Manage monthly billing procedures; communicate any budget variances to clients and close any gaps. Manage accounts receivable process for past due accounts

Requirements and Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s or Advanced degree in Marketing or related field

Virtual Rockstar is hiring a full-time Remote Patient Monitor on behalf of our client — a rapidly growing home-based healthcare organization headquartered in Arkansas. This role is ideal for a compassionate, detail-oriented professional with a nursing background and strong Athena EMR experience who’s passionate about improving patient outcomes through remote care.

As the Remote Patient Monitor, you’ll be responsible for tracking patient health data, conducting outreach calls, and ensuring accurate documentation within Athena EMR. You’ll monitor key vital sign parameters, check for out-of-range readings, and coordinate with providers to ensure timely interventions when needed.

This role is a blend of clinical insight and administrative excellence — perfect for someone who understands patient care but thrives in a structured, data-driven environment.

You’ll play a key role in supporting patients receiving home visits, helping manage their ongoing health data and coordinating communication with their clinical care team.

About Our Client

Our client provides comprehensive mobile primary care and post-hospital follow-up services, specializing in supporting patients who face barriers to traditional healthcare — including seniors and individuals managing chronic conditions. Their team of medical professionals brings high-quality, personalized care directly to patients’ homes, ensuring continuity and compassion every step of the way.

The organization’s mission is to make healthcare more accessible, proactive, and human by combining hands-on home visits with modern remote patient monitoring systems.

Responsibilities

Patient Monitoring & Communication

  • Review and document daily or weekly patient readings such as weight, blood pressure, and glucose levels

  • Call patients to follow up on vitals, medication changes, or symptoms

  • Ask guided clinical questions to assess patient condition and compliance

  • Identify abnormal or out-of-range values and escalate them to the provider team

  • Maintain a compassionate and professional tone with patients, primarily elderly individuals receiving home care

Data Entry & EMR Documentation

  • Enter, review, and update patient data accurately within Athena EMR

  • Create, modify, and maintain templates in Athena for consistent reporting and follow-up documentation

  • Log all communication, notes, and observations for provider review

  • Track and report trends in patient vitals to support proactive care management

Team Collaboration & Administrative Support

  • Communicate with providers and medical staff using Microsoft Teams for updates and escalations

  • Coordinate with the care team to ensure each patient’s remote monitoring aligns with their visit schedules

  • Assist in developing workflow efficiencies and monitoring reports for quality assurance


Requirements

  • Nursing background (LPN, RN, or equivalent education strongly preferred)

  • Experience using Athena EMR is required

  • Knowledge of normal vs. abnormal parameters for common vital signs

  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills (clear, professional, and patient-friendly)

  • Comfort with phone-based patient communication, particularly with elderly patients

  • Excellent attention to detail and accuracy in documentation

  • Reliable technology setup with secure internet connection suitable for HIPAA-compliant work

  • Ability to work collaboratively and independently in a remote setting


Benefits

  • Competitive salary commensurate with experience.

  • Opportunities for professional development and growth.

  • Work in a dynamic and supportive team environment.

  • Make a meaningful impact by helping to build and strengthen families across the globe.

This leader will manage and develop Implementation Consultants and Implementation Project Managers, oversee complex client launches, and create the governance, and cross-functional operating practices needed to deliver consistent, high-quality outcomes. The role partners closely with Sales, Client Success, Product, Engineering/Systems, Operations, Clinical, and other leaders to improve launch readiness, resolve critical issues, and scale implementation capabilities as the business evolves.

The ideal candidate combines strong team leadership with deep implementation judgment. They can move between executive-level client and internal conversations, portfolio-level risks and tradeoffs, and the operating mechanisms that help implementation teams execute effectively. They should be comfortable using implementation and client-performance metrics to identify patterns and prioritize action, without needing to be an advanced data analyst.

People Leadership & Organizational Capacity

  • Lead, develop, and retain a high-performing organization of implementation leaders, consultants, project managers, and related client-facing professionals.

  • Set clear expectations for delivery quality, client experience, collaboration, and accountability; provide coaching, performance management, and career development.

  • Build leadership capacity through succession planning, mentoring, and development of future people leaders.

  • Partner with leadership on staffing, capacity planning, workload distribution, and seasonal readiness across the implementation portfolio.

Portfolio Delivery & Launch Outcomes

  • Oversee end-to-end implementation delivery across the your team’s portfolio, ensuring appropriate strategy, resourcing, governance, and execution for standard, complex, and transformational launches.

  • Establish clear expectations for launch readiness, quality, on-time delivery, post-launch stability, and client transition.

  • Ensure teams identify dependencies, manage scope and timelines, and maintain clear ownership of critical deliverables and decisions.

  • Review portfolio health and intervene early when risks, capacity constraints, or execution issues threaten client or business outcomes.

Client Governance & Executive Escalations

  • Establish effective governance models, operating rhythms, escalation paths, and decision-making practices for complex implementations.

  • Serve as the escalation point for implementation risks and client issues with strategic, commercial, operational, or reputational implications.

  • Build trust through transparent communication, sound judgment, clear recommendations, and consistent follow-through.

Implementation Methodology, Quality & Continuous Improvement

  • Use retrospectives, implementation learnings, client feedback, and performance trends to identify systemic gaps and prioritize improvements.

  • Establish quality controls and adoption mechanisms that improve consistency, reduce avoidable escalations, and increase team efficiency.

  • Ensure improvements are translated into practical guidance, enablement, and repeatable ways of working for implementation teams.

Cross-Functional Operating Model

  • Align Sales, Client Success, Product, Engineering/Systems, Operations, Clinical, and other partners around implementation priorities, dependencies, decisions, and client outcomes.

  • Surface recurring themes and implementation constraints to inform product, process, staffing, and business decisions.

  • Clarify ownership and drive resolution when work crosses organizational boundaries or existing processes are insufficient.

Product, Technical & Operational Readiness

  • Maintain sufficient product, systems, integration, and operational fluency to guide implementation strategy and challenge assumptions effectively.

  • Partner with Product, Engineering/Systems, Care, Clinical, and Support leaders to ensure technology feeds, integrations, claims readiness, operational processes, and member-support pathways are prepared for launch.

  • Ensure client requirements are translated into feasible implementation approaches while balancing client needs, operational sustainability, and scalable delivery.

  • Support the development of tools and reporting that improve visibility into readiness, risks, dependencies, and portfolio performance without taking on day-to-day project administration.

Client Transition & Post-Launch Partnership

  • Partner with Client Success and operational leaders to ensure a clear transition from implementation to ongoing client ownership.

  • Monitor early post-launch performance and ensure material issues have clear owners, communication plans, and durable resolutions.

  • Use implementation outcomes and client feedback to strengthen retention, advocacy, and future growth opportunities.

Required Qualifications

  • 8+ years of progressive experience in SaaS implementation, client onboarding, implementation consulting, program management, or project management; 10+ years preferred.

  • 3+ years of experience leading and developing client-facing implementation or project management professionals, including managers where applicable.

  • Proven experience leading complex, multi-workstream implementations involving significant cross-functional dependencies, technical integrations, operational readiness, and executive stakeholders.

  • Demonstrated ability to lead both strategic implementation consulting and disciplined project/program execution, either directly or through a blended team of consultants and project managers.

  • Proven experience managing risks and escalations, improving quality, and delivering predictable, high-quality launches.

  • Demonstrated executive presence and client leadership skills, including the ability to facilitate senior-level governance forums, navigate difficult conversations, and build alignment across competing priorities.

  • Track record of building scalable implementation methodologies, playbooks, standards, and operating processes that improve consistency, quality, client experience, and team efficiency.

  • Strong cross-functional leadership skills and experience influencing Sales, Client Success, Product, Engineering/Systems, Operations, Clinical, and other partners toward shared client and business outcomes.

  • Experience in healthcare, employee benefits, health technology, or a closely related ecosystem, with the ability to understand client, carrier, partner, and operational requirements.

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and experience.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with healthcare benefits administration, claims operations, carrier ecosystems, or related healthcare data/integration environments.

  • Experience leading organizational change management or operating-model changes.

  • PMP, CSM, or another relevant project/program management certification.

  • Experience using Salesforce, Cloud Coach, Jira, or similar systems to manage implementation portfolios, capacity, risks, and delivery performance.

Are you an organized Project Manager ready to take the next step in your career? Do you thrive in fast-paced environments where you can create structure, drive progress, and make a measurable impact? If so, Codekeeper could be the right place for you.

We're searching for a proactive, hands-on professional who takes ownership and actively contributes to every phase of a project. Our ideal candidate is eager to grow within the industry, comfortable working cross-functionally, and ready to roll up their sleeves to ensure initiatives are delivered on time and to the highest standard. If you are driven, detail-oriented, and committed to delivering results, we would love to hear from you.

We're accepting applications over the next two months and will close the position as soon as we find the right fit - so we encourage early applications.

Role Description:

As a project manager you will be assigned to work on several projects and be responsible for finishing it with good results. Projects will include researching, managing, organizing, etc. Thriving in our dynamic, fast-paced environment requires not only overseeing the progress but actively engaging in every aspect of the project lifecycle. Within our dynamic environment there's always a lot of stuff ongoing where you can jump in!

Key Responsibilities:

  • Innovate and Navigate: Lead the charge from inception to completion, breathing life into project ideas with your visionary planning and strategic execution. Transform abstract concepts into tangible successes, leveraging your unique blend of creativity and analytical skills.
  • Guide and Achieve:Monitor the heartbeat of project progress with an eagle eye, setting ambitious yet attainable deadlines. Your leadership will ensure projects not only stay on track but also sprint toward their goals, exceeding expectations.
  • Communicate and Collaborate: Act as the pivotal bridge between teams and department heads, ensuring a seamless flow of information. Your adept communication skills will foster an environment of clarity and cooperation, driving collective success.
  • Resolve and Propel:Embrace challenges with a problem-solving mindset, navigating through obstacles with agility. Your capacity to identify solutions and make decisive actions will keep projects advancing, even against the odds.
  • Deliver Excellence: Cross the finish line with projects that not only meet the brief but also set new standards of excellence. Your commitment to quality and results will not just complete tasks but will carve out new benchmarks for success.

More about Codekeeper:

Codekeeper was founded by tech industry professionals to revolutionize software escrow for the cloud era. We offer state-of-the-art disaster recovery solutions that mitigate third-party risks in business operations. As a remote-first company with a central office in The Hague, we prioritize a healthy, resilient organization to support the development of our robust app.

What We Offer:

  • Passionate and fun-loving colleagues
  • Startup mindset with ample opportunities for growth
  • Regular team activities and gatherings
  • Comprehensive onboarding process with a dedicated ramp-up period
  • A supportive team that values open communication and direct feedback
  • A chance to excel in your career and make a difference

What we are looking for:

  • Proficiency in utilizing contemporary web tools and technologies such as Zapier, Linear, Google Docs, etc.
  • Prior experience in project management, or in customer service with an emphasis on problem-solving.
  • A proactive doer who's eager to actively participate and tackle challenges head-on.

Additional Requirements:

  • Proficiency in English, covering both written and verbal communication
  • Excellent interpersonal skills.
  • Excellent organizational skills and analytical thinking. A preference for pragmatism over idealism.
  • Ability to adapt, to manage various tasks and able to prioritize

Additional Info:

  • Job Location: Remote (
  • Join us to shape the future of software escrow!

How to Apply

Please send an application that speaks directly to how you would like to fill this position. There are no right answers or expectations. Show us your role in our company’s future and our role in yours. Address some of the work we do. Introduce yourself as a colleague. Feel free to respond in either Dutch or English.

SAP Solution Architect, L7 / L6

Location: Remote

We Are:

Accenture's Commercial Client Success organization helps clients realize measurable business value from their investments by connecting strategy, sales, solutioning, and delivery. Our teams serve as trusted advisors, driving exceptional client experiences, accelerating business outcomes, and helping organizations achieve sustainable growth and transformation.

You Are:

Serve as a Solution Architect for SAP opportunities within mid-sized clients. Lead solutioning for SAP implementations, application development, data migration, governance, managed services, or infrastructure support. Partner with sales, delivery, technical and client teams to design scalable SAP solutions that drive measurable business outcomes. Apply a Forward Deployment Engineering (FDE) mindset to rapidly translate business challenges into executable solutions, prototypes, and transformation roadmaps.

Key Responsibilities:

Solution Architecture & Deal Shaping

  • Design SAP solutions aligned to client requirements, business objectives, and industry best practices.
  • Lead solution planning, estimation, staffing, pricing inputs, and proposal development.
  • Support and lead RFP / RFI responses and complex sales pursuits.
  • Develop implementation approaches, operating models, and transformation roadmaps.
  • Collaborate with sales, architects, technical and delivery teams to create scalable, deliverable solutions.

Client Advisory

  • Build trusted advisor relationships with business and technology stakeholders.
  • Facilitate discovery workshops, design-thinking sessions, and value realization discussions.
  • Advise clients on SAP S/4HANA, SAP Cloud ERP Public Edition, SAP Cloud ERP Private Edition, RISE with SAP Methodology / Journey, SAP Business AI, Generative AI, Data & Analytics, Automation, and SAP BTP.
  • Communicate business value, modernization opportunities, and transformation outcomes.

Engineering & Innovation

  • Apply structured problem-solving, rapid prototyping, and proof-of-concept approaches.
  • Create reusable accelerators, reference architectures, and automation assets.
  • Evaluate emerging SAP, cloud, AI, data, and integration technologies.
  • Drive continuous improvement in solution design, estimation, delivery, and support models.

Leadership

  • Support client, sales, and industry events.
  • Mentor solution architects and contribute to capability development.
  • Develop thought leadership, innovation assets, and best practices.
  • Maintain relevant SAP and cloud certifications.

Travel may be required for this role. The amount of travel will vary from 0 to 100% depending on business need and client requirements.

Here's What You Need:

  • Minimum of 5 years of SAP experience, including SAP S/4HANA, with strong functional and integration exposure.

  • Minimum of 5 years of solution planning, presales, and deal-shaping experience, including RFPs, estimation, staffing, pricing, and executive presentations.

  • Minimum 5 years of Industry experience in any of the following sectors: Public Sector, Manufacturing, Consumer Goods, Life Sciences, High Tech, Chemicals, Industrial Equipment, or related sectors.

  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in cloud transformation or cloud implementation programs.

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent (minimum 12 years) work experience. (If Associate’s Degree, must have minimum 6 years work experience)

Preferred Skills:

  • Experience leading workshops, discovery sessions, and solution design activities including ability to convert business requirements into executable architecture and technical solutions.

  • Strong understanding of end-to-end SAP processes and cross-module integration.

  • Knowledge of SAP Activate, SAP Best Practices, and Clean Core principles.

  • Experience with SAP BTP, Integration Suite, Extension Suite, SAP Build, and SAP Business AI.

  • Strong communication, storytelling, stakeholder management, and executive presentation skills.

  • Excellent analytical, estimation, and solution-planning capabilities.

Bonus Points:

  • Experience in large SAP transformation programs and presales.

  • Value-based selling and business case development expertise.

  • Background in Forward Deployment Engineering, Solution Engineering, or Innovation Architecture.

  • Knowledge of SAP Joule, SAP AI Foundation, Machine Learning, Generative AI, Agile, and DevOps.

  • Contributions to accelerators, reusable frameworks, thought leadership, or innovation initiatives.

About Blue Water Thinking

Guided by our principles of value generation, continuous innovation, customer-centricity, and vested collaboration, Blue Water Thinking proudly supports our Federal clients in achieving their Agency goals.

Founded by a decorated twenty-eight year Veteran of the United States Army, Blue Water Thinking understands and supports the mission of our Nation's war fighters, Veterans, their families and caretakers.

Leveraging our executive team's military experience and private and public sector consulting expertise, Blue Water Thinking takes an integrated "one-team" approach and brings to bear best-fit solutions, thought leadership, and grit to meet our client's transformational needs.

Fueled by our values of integrity, respect, professionalism, stewardship and customer service, the Blue Water Thinking team understands the power of the human connection, collaboration, humility and loyalty to one another, our clients and industry partners.

Lastly, our formula for success is simple: Build something good, take care of our people, keep our clients satisfied, nurture our work ethic and reputation, build long-lasting partnerships, enjoy what we do and give back as much as possible.

Job Description:

Blue Water Thinking is seeking an experienced Senior Data Analyst to support the design, development, and maintenance of enterprise data, automation, and reporting solutions using the Microsoft Power Platform. This role is responsible for developing and supporting Dataverse solutions, automating business processes, troubleshooting data integrations, and delivering reporting and analytics capabilities through Power BI. The ideal candidate will possess hands-on experience with Dataverse, Power Automate, Power Query, Power BI, Dataflows, and Power Platform Application Lifecycle Management (ALM) practices. The majority of data consumed by this role originates from enterprise applications, SharePoint, Excel workbooks, MicroStrategy exports, CSV files, and other file-based sources. Candidates should be comfortable working with diverse data sources and leveraging Power Platform tools to transform, manage, and deliver business solutions. Experience developing Power Apps solutions is highly desirable.

Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, and maintain enterprise data solutions using Dataverse, SharePoint, Microsoft 365, file-based data sources, and approved enterprise systems.
  • Create and maintain Dataverse tables, relationships, business rules, security roles, and scalable data models.
  • Develop and support Power Automate cloud flows, business process flows, and workflow automation solutions.
  • Develop Power BI semantic models, datasets, dashboards, reports, and dataflows utilizing DAX and Power Query best practices.
  • Troubleshoot and optimize Power Query transformations, dataflows, refresh processes, dataset performance, and reporting solutions.
  • Integrate solutions with Microsoft 365 services, SharePoint, Teams, Outlook, Dynamics 365, and authorized external APIs.
  • Support data ingestion, transformation, validation, and reporting processes from enterprise systems and file-based data sources.
  • Deploy and manage Power Platform solutions across Development, Test, and Production environments using ALM best practices.
  • Maintain technical documentation, release notes, test cases, solution diagrams, and support procedures.
  • Provide Level II/III support, troubleshoot production issues, manage enhancements, and conduct user training and knowledge transfer.
  • Collaborate with business stakeholders to gather requirements and translate business needs into scalable Power Platform solutions.
  • Participate in solution design discussions, architecture reviews, and continuous improvement initiatives.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience delivering enterprise data, reporting, automation, or Power Platform solutions.
  • MUST have proven experience using Azure Databricks
  • Hands-on experience designing, developing, and supporting solutions using:
    • Dataverse
    • Power Automate
    • Power BI (semantic models, DAX, reporting, and dashboard development)
    • Power Query
    • Power BI Dataflows and data transformation processes
  • Experience designing and maintaining Dataverse data models, relationships, business rules, security roles, and scalable enterprise solutions.
  • Experience developing and supporting production Power Automate solutions.
  • Experience developing and supporting production Power BI reports, datasets, semantic models, dashboards, and dataflows.
  • Proficiency with:
    • DAX
    • Power Fx
    • JSON
    • REST APIs
    • Microsoft 365 integrations
  • Experience troubleshooting dataflows, refresh failures, data quality issues, and production support incidents.
  • Experience deploying and supporting solutions using Power Platform ALM practices.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, communication, and documentation skills.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience developing Canvas Apps and Model-Driven Apps using Dataverse.
  • Experience integrating Power Platform solutions with SharePoint, Teams, Outlook, Dynamics 365, external APIs, and other enterprise applications.
  • Experience working with Excel, CSV, SharePoint, MicroStrategy exports, and other file-based data sources to support data ingestion, automation, reporting, and analytics solutions.
  • Familiarity with SQL and relational database concepts.
  • Experience with GitHub or Azure DevOps for source control, release management, and deployment pipelines.
  • Experience designing, implementing, or supporting enterprise data lake and analytics platforms.
  • Experience with Microsoft Fabric, OneLake, Azure Data Lake Storage, Data Factory, or similar cloud-based analytics technologies.
  • Experience with enterprise data governance, security, retention, auditing, and compliance requirements.
  • Experience supporting Power Platform solutions in healthcare, federal government, or other complex enterprise environments.

Eligibility:

  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.
  • Must be able to obtain and maintain the required federal public trust clearance for this role.

Compensation:

Salary for this position is determined by various factors, including but not limited to, location, the candidate’s particular combination of knowledge, skills, competencies, and experience, as well as contract specific affordability and organizational requirements. The proposed salary range for this position is outlined below.

Salary Range: $135,000 - $150,000

raw.description:
About us:

Airtm is a financial-infrastructure company building the future of the online-work economy. We are on a mission to empower the world's growing number of Digital Entrepreneurs in the Global South, giving them the financial freedom to thrive.
The problem is clear: in emerging markets, accessing the dollar economy is difficult. Cross-border payments are slow, expensive, and often lose value to inflation. This limits the potential of millions of talented individuals.
Airtm’s solution is a swift and comprehensive financial platform that facilitates low-value cross-border payments and local cash-outs. As pioneers in stablecoin-payment infrastructure, Airtm has built the most advanced cross-border payment system available on the market.
As a company married to the world of online work, Airtm will go beyond payments to build the necessary infrastructure the online-work economy needs to thrive. We are fostering an entirely new economy, giving individuals, communities, and countries the tools to take control of their financial destinies.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer to design, build, and evolve the full stack systems that power Airtm’s financial products. You’ll work within one of our autonomous product pods, taking ownership of projects end-to-end, from technical design through production, and mentoring the engineers around you.

Our stack is TypeScript/Node.js microservices deployed on Kubernetes, paired with React front ends. You’ll work across the entire stack, backend and frontend, as needed to deliver on your pod’s goals, collaborating with engineers in other pods when initiatives cross boundaries. AI-assisted development is core to how we build software: you’ll be expected to use AI coding tools fluently to move faster without sacrificing quality.

Key Responsibilities

  • Technical Design: Lead the design of medium-to-large features across the stack, document decisions, and anticipate edge cases and long-term maintainability
  • Full Stack Development: Build and maintain TypeScript/Node.js microservices, event handlers, and cronjobs, as well as the React UIs that consume them, powering our core financial flows
  • AI-Assisted Development: Use AI coding assistants and agentic tools as part of your daily workflow, from scaffolding and refactoring to test generation and code review, while maintaining a high bar for correctness and judgment about when and how much to rely on them
  • Project Ownership: Break down complex problems into actionable work across multiple services and UIs; drive delivery from design through deployment
  • Code Quality: Write well-tested, maintainable code; conduct thorough code reviews (including AI-generated code) and hold a high bar for the team
  • Mentorship: Mentor junior and mid-level engineers, including on effective and responsible use of AI tooling; share knowledge and elevate the team’s technical practices
  • Cross-Pod Collaboration: Coordinate with engineers in other pods when work crosses service boundaries; contribute code to shared services following established ownership guidelines
  • On-Call: Participate in on-call rotation for services the pod owns; lead incident response and post-incident reviews
  • Technical Debt: Proactively identify and address technical debt; balance short-term delivery with long-term health of the systems

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with demonstrated full stack range (backend services and frontend UIs)
  • Proficiency in TypeScript and Node.js for building production services
  • Proficiency in React for building production-facing UIs (state management, component design, performance)
  • Experience designing and building REST or GraphQL APIs
  • Solid understanding of relational databases (PostgreSQL or similar), modeling, query optimization, and migrations
  • Familiarity with event-driven architecture and messaging patterns (Kafka, SQS, or similar)
  • Experience working in a microservices environment
  • Hands-on, day-to-day experience with AI-assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, Zed’s Agentic editing, or similar) for coding, debugging, and code review; comfort with prompt/context engineering and sound judgment about validating AI-generated output
  • Strong grasp of software design principles: separation of concerns, error handling, testing strategies
  • Experience writing unit, integration, and end-to-end tests
  • Comfort operating in a cloud environment (AWS preferred), understanding of deployments, logs, and basic infrastructure concepts
  • Strong communication skills; proactive about sharing progress, blockers, and technical risks

Nice to Have

  • Experience building or integrating AI/LLM-powered features into products (RAG, agents, tool calling, prompt pipelines)
  • Familiarity with Kubernetes and container-based deployments
  • Background in fintech, payments, or financial systems
  • Experience working with GraphQL (schema design, federation, or tooling)
  • Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines (Bitbucket Pipelines, GitHub Actions, ArgoCD)
  • Familiarity with observability tooling (Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana)
  • Experience mentoring engineers or leading technical design discussions

What We Look For

Beyond the technical skills, we’re looking for engineers who:

  • Take ownership, they drive their work to completion and communicate early when something is at risk
  • Write code for the next engineer, clean, tested, and documented, whether they or an AI tool wrote the first draft
  • Improve the team around them, through reviews, mentorship, and knowledge sharing
  • Collaborate across boundaries, they engage other pods constructively when work crosses service lines
  • Have good technical judgment, they balance pragmatism with quality, know when to push back on scope, and know when (and when not) to lean on AI tooling

raw.description:
About Virtualitics

Virtualitics is the category leader in AI-native readiness applications for defense, government, and critical infrastructure. Founded on a decade of Caltech research in partnership with NASA/JPL, we are led by scientists, strategists, and servicemembers united by a single mission: to solve the world’s most complex, mission-critical challenges with AI.

Our Readiness AI solutions deliver operational certainty — giving leaders and operators a clear picture of what’s ready, what’s at risk, and what to do next. By identifying risks early, diagnosing root causes, and recommending prioritized actions with transparent, explainable AI, we help organizations move from data complexity to decision advantage.

Behind that impact is relentless innovation. Inventors at heart, we hold 15+ U.S. patents and are leading the shift toward agent-driven readiness. But what truly sets us apart is our culture — relentless about results, grounded in transparency, and driven by compassion for the mission and the people it serves.

If you’re motivated by impact, inspired by technical depth, and ready to build AI that performs where it matters most — you’ll find your mission here.

Location: Remote, with up to 50% travel to assigned customer locations. Candidates residing near an Air Force base are highly preferred.

This position will work on Department of War munitions related projects. You must be authorized to work in the US without sponsorship with the ability to obtain a security clearance, which is issued by the U.S. government. U.S. citizenship is required by the DoW and IC for security clearance.

*Secret clearance required


What You Will Be Doing

  • Support the Solution Leader with providing munitions subject matter expertise to deliver training and enablement for the Virtualitics Readiness AI platform

  • Serve as an embedded Virtualitics representative traveling to multiple customer sites, assisting the Solution Leader with the day to day relationship with end users and acting as the primary training and enablement point of contact

  • Provide customer with technical operational knowledge to leverage the Virtualitics AI products to obtain mission value

  • Act as the customer advocate within Virtualitics by representing the customer’s needs, escalating pain points through daily touchpoints with engineering and product teams, and ensuring a positive customer experience

  • Deliver hands-on training and enablement as the subject matter expert for customer mission integration, working alongside mission teams in a variety of formats

  • Coordinate on-site technical operations with the Virtualitics Solution Leader (both on-site and remote) for platform data insight capabilities

  • Collect, analyze, and report customer feedback and ground truth; as the most forward-deployed representative of Virtualitics, you observe what’s working and what’s not and ensure that information flows back to the company

  • Assist the Solution Leader for planning required onsites with the customer e.g., office space, equipment readiness, logistics, scheduling, and resource coordination

  • Assist Solution Leader with customer classified engagements. Drive adoption of Virtualitics Readiness AI solutions through persistent, relationship-driven engagement with end users

  • Uphold Virtualitics’ brand, image, and values through professional conduct and consistent service delivery

  • Support personnel compliance tracking including clearance status, NDA completion, CAC management, and training requirements

What We Are Looking For

  • 5+ years of experience working in or directly supporting Department of War munitions operations

  • Demonstrated technical aptitude, comfortable with data platforms, analytics tools, and translating technical capabilities into operational outcomes

  • Experience operating autonomously in demanding environments with minimal supervision; this role requires the judgment and initiative of an experienced SNCO or O-3/O-4 officer with munitions experience

  • Strong problem-solving skills and a track record of delivering results in high-performing teams under aggressive timelines

  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills; you will engage daily with end users, senior leadership, and technical teams across all organizational levels

  • Ability to travel and work onsite at various customer sites to include CONUS and OCONUS locations

  • Must be able to maintain a Secret security clearance (U.S. citizenship required)

What Are Our Preferred Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree preferred; or comparable on-the-job munitions storage experience in lieu of degree

  • Active Secret clearance

  • Prior military service as an SNCO (E-7 to E-9) or officer (O-3 to O-4) is highly valued

What Are Some Valued Skills

  • Domain expertise in DoW munitions operational areas; i.e. stockpile, storage, warehousing Experience as a Field Service Representative, Forward Deployed Engineer, or embedded technical advisor in a defense technology company

  • Familiarity with coordinating multi-disciplinary teams across classified and unclassified environments

  • Experience proactively identifying risks and optimizing cross-team collaboration in fast-paced operational settings

  • Comfort with operational readiness workflows including security compliance, access management, and personnel tracking

  • Previous experience serving on a Service’s major command staff; i.e. MAJCOM or equivalent supporting munitions OT&E functions

What we offer you

At Virtualitics, you’ll join a high-performance team of scientists, strategists, and servicemembers building AI that operates in the world’s most demanding environments. The problems we solve matter — and so does the opportunity to grow while solving them.

You’ll have meaningful ownership from day one, with the ability to accelerate your career alongside a company scaling rapidly in national security and critical infrastructure.

We offer highly competitive compensation, meaningful equity participation, and fully paid medical, dental, and vision coverage for you and your dependents. Our benefits also include unlimited PTO and flexible work arrangements, with remote flexibility and hybrid options for team members based in the Los Angeles or Washington, DC areas.
